concepts.definition: Māshrā is a Suryānī word which literally means acute inflammation of any part of body due to predominance of Dam (blood/sanguine) and Ṣafrā’ (yellow bile). Ancient Unani physicians have used this word for the inflammation of face and forehead. Ibn Sīnā had included this term for the acute inflammation of liver which is caused exclusively by the predominance of Ṣafrā’ (yellow bile). But most recent Unani physicians describe this as an acute inflammation of face and forehead in which the face becomes red and swollen accompanied with pain and itching.

concepts.definition: Accumulation of fluid in the head. This can be of two types, either the accumulation is beneath the scalp or inside the head. If it occurs inside the head, the patient experiences heaviness of head, eyes remain open with continuous lacrimation and this is usually a fatal condition. When the fluid is accumulated beneath the scalp due to bad obstetric procedure, it is usually curable and subsides gradually (caput succeedenum).

Sometimes, he attacks other persons due to irritation. He makes noises resembling with dog and cock. Ulcers of calf muscles are also observed in these patients.

concepts.definition: Headache due to inhalation of pungent odour or strong smells.

concepts.definition: Headache in the crisis/critical stage of diseases.

concepts.definition: A type of tension occurring at both ends of the muscles causing maximum stretching of the muscles.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of tension occurring in the muscles of cervical and thoracic vertebrae, making them elongated.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Tension of the anterior muscles of cervical and thoracic vertebrae.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Tension of the posterior muscles of cervical and thoracic vertebrae.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Tension of the whole muscles of the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Tension of muscles of one side of the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Kuzāz that occurs due to exposure of cold.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Tetanus that occurs in new born due to the wound of umbilical cord.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Tetanus that occurs due to injury or wound.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A disease of the facial muscles in which face is deviated to either side. In this condition patient cannot close his eyes on the affected side and lips, completely. Saliva continues to dribble from the angles of the mouth. When the patient blows, air comes out from one side of the mouth. When this disease is bilateral there is no deviation of face but lips and eyes do not close completely.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: deviation of one side of face due to flaccidity of muscles
concepts.definition: Deviation of face due to flaccidity of the facial muscles.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: deviation of one side of face due to spasm of muscles
concepts.definition: Deviation of face due to spasm of the facial muscles.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Shivering of the organs of the body due to the weakness or defect in motor system. It is a mixture of voluntary and involuntary movements of the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: tremor due to cold morbid temperament
concepts.definition: A type of Ra‘sha caused by simple cold morbid temperament of the organ.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Shivering of the organs due to increased/habitual intake of alcohol.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Trembling of muscles. It occurs due to the predominance of Ruṭūbat (moistness) in the brain.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The complete/partial loss of sensation of any organ of the body. According to causes it can be of four types i. e. Balghamī (phlegmatic), Damawī (sanguineous), Sawdāwī (melancholic) and Ṣafrāwī (bilious).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Involuntary movement of the muscles of organs e.g. eyelids, heart, stomach and spleen that can be felt on the skin also. According to aetiology it is of two types: Ikhtilāj Bārid (chronic) and Ikhtilāj Ḥārr (acute).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Diseases of Eye

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is considered as an inflammation of conjunctiva of eye which is Ḥārr (acute) in nature. Sometimes only the pain of eyes is known as Ramad. In this condition eyelids become swollen, eyes become red with continuous watering.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is a type of Ramad caused by the predominance of Dam (sanguine) in the surrounding areas of brain and its infiltration into eyes. It is characterized by redness of eyes, swelling, engorgement of vessels of eyes, temporal region of face, pulsation at temporal region, decreased lacrimation and purulent discharge.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of Ramad caused by the predominance of Ṣafrā’ (yellow bile) and its infiltration into the area surrounding the eye. It is characterized by severe pain from the beginning, pricking sensation, excessive lacrimation but comparatively less redness in the eyes.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of Ramad caused by excessive intake of milk and other diets that produce phlegm. It is also associated with extreme cold condition and catarrh. In this condition, eyes appear to be wet with little redness, pain and discharge.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of Ramad caused by dryness of temperament as a result of excessive intake of black bile producing diets. It is characterized by dryness and discoloration of eyes with decreased lacrimation and less stickiness of eyes. It is a long lasting condition.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of Ramad accompanied with lacrimation and shifting pain. It is caused by accumulation of thick vapours coming from the brain towards conjunctiva. In this condition there is distension and radiation of pain towards the head, eyes and face.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inflammation of conjunctiva which appears as a hard white nodule due to accumulation of phlegm. It resembles fat in its colour but not in consistency. If it is due to accumulation of Dam (blood/sanguine) its colour is red. It is found on inner canthus, outer canthus, below eyelids and around cornea in a beaded manner.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An infectious inflammation of conjunctiva due to gonorrhoea. It is associated with severe pain and redness of eyes.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: conjunctivitis due to staring at snow
concepts.definition: The inflammation of conjunctiva caused by continuous staring at snow.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Redness of eye due to sub acute inflammation with moderate symptoms. Redness of the eyes is also mild leading to dirty eyes.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Its literal meaning is “flowing of tears” which is an essential feature of this disease. It is a type of covering which is caused due to the dilatation of outer vessels of eye and covers the surface of conjunctiva and cornea. On appearance it appears to be a white thin layer.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: moist covering on the surface of conjunctiva
concepts.definition: A type of vascular keratitis which is characterized by the presence of fluid in the eyelids, itching, pain of the eyes and sneezing.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: dry covering on the surface of conjunctiva
concepts.definition: It is a type of vascular keratitis characterised by the presence of the covering or layer on the surface of conjunctiva and cornea. This condition is usually asymptomatic.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: thick covering on the surface of conjunctiva
concepts.definition: A type of vascular keratitis in which the thick layer covers the cornea completely. The condition is caused by the congestion of vessels with viscous fluids.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition much similar to Ramad Yābis (dry conjunctivitis) with partial loss of vision. In this condition there is opacity of layers of eyes. They seem to be dirty, reddish and fogging. This is characterized by slow movement of the eye, apparent enlargement of the eye with itching which is relieved only by warm water.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A chronic inflammation of conjunctiva accompanied with itching.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Swelling of eye that appears abruptly and deviates towards the inner canthus. There is some itching before the appearance of swelling. This swelling generally appears in summers and in old persons. It is white in colour similar to phlegmatic swelling.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The swelling is more viscous than Intifākh Rīḥī and pitting sign remains on the swelling for sometimes.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: distension of conjunctiva due to fluid
concepts.definition: Swelling without any sign of pitting. There is no itching and pain of eye.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Hard swelling with bluish colouring. It usually occurs after chronic conjunctivitis or small pox. It usually occurs in the whole eye.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A disease in which outer surface of cornea becomes white and opaque. This layer or covering is also known as Ghamām, Abr and Saḥāb.When the opacity lies in the cornea it is known as Bayāḍ. This condition occurs in post corneal ulcers, conjunctivitis, and migraine. It may also be caused by regular irritation of cornea leading to its ulcers, trichiasis, trachoma, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A projection or growth from the inner canthus of eye towards cornea. It is also known as Ẓufra. The projection is muscular, membranous or nervine in nature. It is of four types: 1.Thin like membrane and starts from one side of conjunctiva. It resembles Sabal. 2. Arises from the fat of inner canthus and stops after reaching cornea. 3. Covers the cornea leading to disturbance of vision or complete loss of vision. 4. Rare type which either appears from conjunctiva or sclera.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of glandular tumour which occurs at the inner canthus of eye. This often covers the lacrimal gland duct preventing the passage of tears.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Ulcers may occur anywhere in the eye but detected only when conjunctiva, cornea and iris are involved. These are caused by acute and burnt humours which infiltrate the layers of eyes causing the ulceration therein. These are caused by the trauma with sharp objects, maltreatment of conjunctivitis and small pox.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An eye ulcer characterized by a red spot on conjunctiva or sometimes whole conjunctiva becomes red.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Ulcers of iris which are seen as a red spot behind the cornea in which arteries are prominent. Such ulcers often tear the cornea.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Ulcers that present as a white spot in cornea. Corneal ulcers may be superficial and deep. There are four types of superficial ulcers of cornea and three types of deep ulcers.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: These are superficial corneal ulcers, and are of four types: 1. Qatlām (Ulcus Serpens): These ulcers appear as cloudy, grey area covering most of the cornea. The cornea becomes lustreless. 2. Saḥāb: This is also cloudy but covers small portion of cornea. It is also known as Qānāliyūn. 3. Iklīl (marginal ulcer): These ulcers are in the shape of crown of king that is why these are known as Iklīl. These ulcers occur at the margins of cornea and extend towards conjunctiva. It is also known as Arkhāniyūn.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: These are deep corneal ulcers and are of three types: 1. Jāwarsiyya: These are the millet shaped ulcers of cornea which is deep with little cicatrisation. These are also known as Luqutūn. 2. Ḥafira: These are deep and wide ulcers of cornea. These are also known as Qūlūma. 3. Iḥtirāqī: These are also deep ulcers with much cicatrisation. These are also known as Abīqūma and Ḥaqīqāwūma.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Ulcers appearing in the cornea with spreaded vessels like web. It often occurs in other layers of eyes also.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: These are the eruptions occurring on the outer, middle and inner layers of cornea. These are caused either by fluids that are less in quantity but bad in quality or vice versa.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is a suppurative ulcer covering the whole cornea. It is caused by impairment of humour pouring towards the eyes and their putrefaction etc. It is characterized by the presence of a large sized ulcer covering whole of cornea and severe pain.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is a type of cancer occupying most of the cornea. It represents itself as the accumulation of thick pus on cornea with redness of vessels surrounding the cornea. It is caused by the infiltration of bad quality black bile along with the inability of cornea to remove that matter. It is characterized by severe pain especially during movement or seeing towards sun or fire, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is a condition of accumulation of infiltrated thick fluids on the cornea. It is characterized by cloudy cornea and diminished vision. Patient’s eyes remain wet and he/she endures continuous nasal discharge.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is the spasm of cornea leading to diminished vision and dry eye.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Chronic inflammation of the inner canthus of eye leading to the flow of tears continuously. This is caused by the presence of abscess, pustules, boils in the inner canthus which ruptures to form fistula.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is a small abscess like swelling not greater than gram (a grain) and appearing in between the inner canthus and nose. It is caused by the flow of morbid matter on to the site of swelling.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is a depression in the inner canthus of eye filled with pus. It is caused by putrefaction of humour within the inner canthus.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Change in the colour of eye due to injury. This change is either due to contusion or sub mucosal haemorrhage of eye.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition in which eyes become cyanosed or bluish coloured because of haemorrhage after injury.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A red spot on the palpebral conjunctiva due to rupture of vessels of eye after injury or congestion.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Foreign body in the eye. It can be dirt, dust, insect, etc. which causes irritation in the eye.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A disease in which there is prolapse of iris due to rupture of cornea after corneal ulcers. It resembles the head of an ant i.e. why it is given the name of Morsarj that is ant’s head.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of prolapse of iris in which iris resembles the shape of the head of house fly.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of prolapse of iris in which iris resembles the shape of grape.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of prolapse of iris which resembles the shape of an apple. It is an extended form of prolapse which reaches up to eyelid and cause hindrance in closing the eye.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: iris prolapse similar to flattened head of nail
concepts.definition: When the Tuffāḥī type of prolapse of iris becomes chronic and gets attached to the ulcerated corneal margins, it is known as Mismārī.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Most of the Unani physicians regard both the terms as synonymous but Dā’ūd Anṭākī has differentiated these terms by saying that Ittisā‘ or dilatation of pupils is a disease where as Intishār or the blurring of vision is a symptom which is caused by dilatation of pupil. According to the causes Ittisā‘ or dilatation of pupils can be of many types: Waramī (inflammatory), Yubsī (decrease in aqueous humour), Ḍarbī (traumatic), Māddī (organic) and Ruṭūbī (excess of aqueous humour).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Narrowing or constriction of pupils that causes disturbances of vision.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Protrusion of the anterior part of cornea due to corneal ulcers caused by pneumococci. In this condition only the descement membrane protrudes because of increase in the intra ocular pressure.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Opacity of Ruṭūbat Jalīdiyya (lens) of the eye. In this condition patient initially feels disturbance in vision e.g. polyopia, coloured halos, seeing of objects like fly, hair, etc. It has three stages i.e. immature, mature and hypermature.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: immature cataract resembling the blackish cloud
concepts.definition: A type of immature cataract in which there is cloudy fluid which is immovable.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of immature cataract which resembles with that of mercury and appears moving in sunlight.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: immature cataract resembling the piece of lime
concepts.definition: A type of immature cataract which resembles with lime stone.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: immature cataract resembling the sky colour
concepts.definition: A type of immature cataract whose colour resembles with that of sky.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A fluid like immature cataract. The vision of patient gradually increases or decreases.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A disease of eye in which there is excessive production of humours and reduction in its absorption. This excess leads to the increase in tension and size of eye ball, gradual decrease in vision, etc. It has four types: Ḥādd (acute), Muzmin (chronic), Nawbatī (episodic) and Thānwī (secondary).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Protrusion of the eyeball.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of protrusion of eyeball that is due to the congestion of eye ball with humours.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: protrusion of eyeball due to compression
concepts.definition: Protrusion of eyeball due to increased pressure on eye ball as seen in strangulation, vomiting, severe headache, crying, straining for bowels, straining for labour or child birth.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: protrusion of eyeball due to structural loosening
concepts.definition: Protrusion of eye ball due to paresis of eye muscles and ligaments attached to it.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: In this condition there is a reduction in humours of eyes because of which different layers of eye and eye as a whole become shrunken. The disease affects mostly older people, but sometimes it affects younger people and children. This is characterized by the adherent eyelids and loss of vision.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Whitish discoloration or depigmentation of eyes due to impaired temperament of iris. This impaired temperament is caused by the presence of viscous humours in it.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: In this condition there is an impairment of vision due to strain during reading, watering of eyes and blurring. It is caused by cold and hot impaired temperament either simple or organic. It is also caused by old age due to excess of Ruṭūbat Faḍliyya (waste material) in the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: False perception of images or objects which actually do not exist. This is due to congestion of morbid humours in brain and nerves. These include: 1. Seeing of pillars of smoke which is divided into many branches later. 2. Seeing of sparkles in front of eye. It is due to the compression of arteries. 3. Seeing of white objects. 4. Seeing of objects bigger than their size. 5. Seeing of objects smaller than their size. 6. Seeing of multiple objects or polyopia. 7. Seeing of objects falling down.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The increased convexity of lens of the eye due to which patient cannot see distant objects.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The increased concavity of lens of eye due to which patient is unable to see the nearer objects.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition in which patient especially children use their one eye. When they use both eyes, they see double images of the objects due to different curvatures of eyes. The condition may be congenital due to epilepsy, weakness of the muscles of eye, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A disease in which patient cannot see properly in dim light and at night. It is due to the accumulation of specific viscous humours which affect optic channels. At day time these viscous humours get dissolved due to increase of temperature, sunlight and physical activity and the patient sees properly at daytime.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A disease in which patient cannot see properly in day light. It is due to dissolution of Rūḥ Bāṣira (optic pneuma) and humours of eyes in sunlight.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Its literal meaning is small eye. In this disease, the patient finds it difficult to see clearly in daylight and is unable to tolerate the rays of the sun. Its cause is thinning of cornea and iris.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of disturbance or fatigue of vision which is caused by the continuous seeing at snow. In this condition sun’s rays from the snow get reflected towards eyes making the vision blurred. This condition occurs not only by continuous staring at snow but it may also be caused by staring at any other bright object also. The condition mainly affects person who travel a lot in snow. The glare of the sun’s rays cause defect of vision in such persons.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.preferredTerm: Dhahāb al-Baṣar fi’l Maṭāmīr wa’l Ḥubūs al-Muẓlima
concepts.transliteration: Dhahab al-Basar fi’l Matamir wa’l Hubus al-Muzlima
aliases: Dhahāb al-Baṣar fi’l Maṭāmīr wa’l Ḥubūs al-Muẓlima
ذهاب البصر في المطامير والحبوس المظلمة
blurring of vision due to long stay in darkness
concepts.definition: A condition in which patient’s pupils get dilated after staying in dark room for a long time. When he comes out, the sun rays cause blurring of vision.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The intolerance of light by eyes. It may be caused either by conditions of the eye itself e.g. corneal ulcers, uveitis, kerato conjunctivitis etc. or by some cranial disorders e.g. migraine, trigeminal neuralgia, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The drooping of upper eyelids due to paralysis of eye muscles or congenitally due to the defect of the muscles of eye. It may also be associated with conjunctivitis. Sometimes tumours or any inflammation of eyelids also cause drooping.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Prolapse of iris due to corneal ulcers.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A disease in which there is an adherence of eyelids after conjunctivitis or some inflammation of eyelids, burn, injury, etc. It can be of two types: 1. adhesion of both eyelids, 2. adhesion of eyelids with eye ball. It is due to some diseased condition of eyeball e.g. corneal ulcers, surgery for Pterygium, trachoma, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Incomplete closure of the eyelids due to stricture and inversion of eyelids. It may be congenital or caused by the inflammation of eyelids, paresis of the muscles of eyelids, malsuturing of eyelids after surgery.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inversion of the eyelids towards the eyeball. This can be congenital, after surgery of eyelids or paralysis of muscles of eyelids. It may be due to scar formation or spasm of muscles.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Aversion of the eyelid i.e. away from the eyeball.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition in which there is thickening and hardening of eyelids due to accumulation of cold and viscous humours. This condition generally occurs after trachoma.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of hardening of eyelid caused by the presence of acute humours in it and is characterized by redness of eyes, itching, falling of eye lashes. It is of two types: acute and chronic.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: These are the ticks found at the root of eyelids. The causative factors include excessive intake of bad quality food, lack of exercise, lack of bathing, along with pouring of putrefied matter towards eyelids.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is the graying of eyelashes. It usually occurs in winters and old age. It may be congenital or may be caused by phlegmatic viscous humour.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is a small swelling on the external surface of eyelids. It may occur in the central part or on the sides. It is caused by excessive use of diets that produce thick humour which deflects towards eyelids. It leads to difficulty in the movements of eyelids.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is a reddish swelling on the external surface of eyelids. On examination it appears as an insect bite. It is caused by sanguine, yellow bile or mixture of both with the addition of phlegm. It usually affects the children and youngsters.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is a condition in which the margins of eyelids get cracked with falling of few eyelashes. The margins are red in color with eruptions. It usually occurs in children and youngsters during summer. It is caused by the accumulation of burnt bilious matter on the eyelids. Initially the pain in the eyelids seems to be simulating with ant bite.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is a wart appearing on the external surface of eyelids. It is caused by putrefaction of melancholic humour (predominated by cold) flowed into the eyelids.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is of four types: Laḥmiyya, Shaḥmiyya, Shahdiyya, ‘Aṣā’idiyya. It commonly arises during the old age. It is caused by excessive intake of phlegm producing diets and flowing of phlegmatic matter into the eyelids.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is the excessive trembling of eye lids. It is caused by falling of a foreign body in eyes and accumulation of thick gases in the eye lids. It is the body’s mechanism to get rid of these thick gases from the eyelids.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is an acute inflammation which occurs in the inner side of upper or lower eyelids or both. The causative factors include sanguineous matter coming towards eyelids or mixing of yellow bile with sanguineous matter.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is a type of hardness of conjunctiva with difficult eye movement. It is caused by infiltration of thick dry humours towards conjunctiva. It is characterized by slight redness accompanied by difficult movement of eyelids especially after waking up, slight pain and foreign body sensation in the eyes.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Small pustules in the internal surface of eyelids which cause watering of eye and itching.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Itching of eyes characterised by roughness of eyelids associated with itching and hardening of eyes.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: granulation of eyelids with eruptions similar to prickly heat
concepts.definition: Pustules caused by presence of acute and foul humours in the eyelids.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: granulation of eyelids with eruptions similar to fig
concepts.definition: When the pustules of eyelids look like fig.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Black eruptions of eyelids with scarring. It is a malignant type.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Lentil shaped eruptions of the eye lids.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of itching of eye lids due to accumulation of saline humours on them. This causes watering of eyes and ulceration.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A fatty swelling of the inner surface of upper eye lids which is chronic in nature. The swelling is immovable. In this condition, there is difficulty in lifting the eye lids, photophobia and watering of eyes.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A phlegmatic swelling of the eyelid which is movable. It appears as a hail on the internal surface of eyelids.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of tumour found in the internal surface of eyelids due to viscous humour which later on becomes hard. It is of three types: 1. Mutaḥarrik i.e. movable e.g. cyst 2. hard type which is immovable 3. Munbasiṭ i.e. spread over the eyelid. Its thickness is not marked. Sometimes it appears reddish in colour with prominent vessels.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An inflammation of the root of eye lashes followed by pus formation, swelling, pain and oedema of eyelids.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An inflammation of the internal surface of eyelids in which signs of inflammation are more severe with more redness, pain and swelling.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of malignant swelling caused by black bile. It is of two types: Dāmiya and ‘Āmiya.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: stony swelling of inner surface of eyelid
concepts.definition: Hardness of eyelids caused by viscous black humour.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Ulcers of eyelids that can be caused by injury to the eye or by infection.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Oedema or swelling of the eyelids caused by defect in the digestive faculties of the organs e.g. in anaemia.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inversion of eyelashes. Inverted eyelashes cause continuous irritation of the eyeball leading to corneal ulcers, pain and watering of eyes.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Growth of eyelashes from the internal edge of eyelid which create disturbance of vision. The condition is caused by infected fluids which get accumulated at the margins of eyes.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Falling of eyelashes caused by malnutrition, waste humours, yellow bile or black bile. As a result of this dirt, dust and sunrays enter the eye easily causing itching, pain and disturbance of vision.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Lice of eyelids caused by the accumulation of putrified, infected fluids.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A disease in which there is continuous watering of eyes without trichiasis or any other disease of eye. It is caused by improper management of Pterygium or accumulation of fluid in head and eyes.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Continuous flow of two or three drops of tears at frequent intervals. It is due to the thickening of upper eyelid because of congestion, increased intake of alcohol and sleeplessness. When the thickened eyelid gets in contact with the other eyelid, tears roll down from the eyes.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: Degeneration of the retina and choroid
concepts.definition: The degenerative changes in retina and choroid may be congenital or due to malnutrition and old age. It often leads to blindness.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Sclerosis and thickening of the walls of smaller arteries of retina.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition where retina is detached from choroid. There is subluxation of retina inwards because of pressure from outside.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: Diseases of Ear, Nose and Throat
concepts.definition: Diseases of Ear, Nose and Throat

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Pain of the ear can be due to cold and coryza, dental caries, foreign body or water in the ear, maggots of the ear, cleaning of ear with some sharp object, joint pain, ulcers or pustules in the ear, wax of the ear. The condition is marked by redness of ear and burning sensation with piercing pain.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Diminished power of hearing. It can be traumatic, congenital, senile, after acute diseases, hot and cold impaired temperament of ear, infiltration of viscous humours in auditory nerve, obstruction in the ear passage by ear polyp, foreign body or tumours.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Complete loss of hearing.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An anomaly where patient has no external ear opening.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition in which patient hears non existing voices. The condition can be continuous or intermittent. When the sound is of high pitch it is known as Ṭanīn and when the sound is of low pitch it is known as Dawī. It is due to general weakness, under nourishment, congestion of head with fluids and morbid material ,weakness of the hearing faculties, presence of wax in the ear, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Bleeding from the ear due to trauma or injury of the ear, insect and reptile bite, congestion of arteries and their rupture. It is often seen in the critical phase of some diseases.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Maggots in the ear cavity are due to deposition of wax, cold and coryza, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inflammation of ear which is of two types: acute and chronic. It is caused by predominance of humours, irritation of auditory nerve, syringing of ear, gout, joint pain and lymphadenitis.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Discharge of fluid from the external auditory meatus. The condition is common in children and persons with wet temperament. Its causes are chronic catarrh, ulcer or swelling of external auditory meatus, pustules of ear, exposure to cold environment, foreign body, acute infective diseases, during teething period in children, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Severe itching of the ear caused by predominance of yellow bile, maggots, wax, ulcers and pustules, predominance of gases in the ear, insect bite and diversion of saline fluids towards ear.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Breaking of the cartilage of ear due to trauma or injury.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Detachment of the pinna by severe pulling of ear or inflammation and gases inside.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The disease mostly affects children. It starts with the roughness of ear and fissures followed by discharge of yellowish fluids, itching and pruritus.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The hypersensitivity of the auditory nerve due to which patient cannot tolerate loud sounds. It is caused by weakness of the hearing faculties of brain.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Obstruction of the external meatus of ear. It may be congenital or acquired. Congenital type can be due to imperforated meatus, polyps or membrane. Acquired type can be due to fibrosis after inflammation or foreign body of the ear. In this condition, patient cannot hear the sounds.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition where the wax in the ear becomes viscous and hard thereby causing hindrance in hearing. It is caused by improper cleaning of ear, dirt, dust, cold and catarrh, continuous irritation of the ear, use of sharp corrosive ear drops and increased activity of wax producing apparatus.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A very common condition of the ear characterized by the presence of eruptions in the ear.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: These are the ulcers of ear which develop as a result of bursting of swelling and eruptions. It is characterized by discharge of pus from the ears.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Foreign body in the ear can be living and non-living. Living foreign body may be insects, flies. Non-living foreign body may be grains, rice, seeds and beads.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: ورم اصل الاذن/ ورم غدۂ نکف
concepts.definition: A type of inflammation that is usually dangerous and spreads in the form of epidemic. It may also appear in the form of parotid gland abscess, characterized by delirium, confusion and sometimes death. This is caused by morbid humours.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The flow of catarrhal fluids from the brain towards nose and throat. Some physicians have differentiated them by saying that while the flow of these fluids towards nose is known as Zukām the flow towards throat is known as Nazla. If the symptoms are intense then it is known Nazla-o-Zukām Ḥārr (acute). If these are of low intensity then it is known as Nazla-o-Zukām Bārid (chronic).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Infiltration of discharge from the head towards ear which blocks the eustachian tube leading to defect in hearing.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Loss of sense of smell.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Impairment of the sense of smell. The condition is manifested in three forms: 1. smelling of only one kind of odour due to loss of olfactory faculty of the brain caused by its impaired temperament or the accumulation of one type of humour in the forebrain, 2. smelling of different odours at a time. This is due to presence of different kinds of humour in the brain, 3. smelling of fragrances only and not of bad odours, 4. smelling of only bad odours and not fragrances.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Eruptions in the nasal cavity that may be due to accumulation of acute humours resulting in their putrefaction.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Ulcers of nose which may be Marṭūb (wet), Khushk (dry) and ‘Afina (infected). They are produced by the accumulation of acute and morbid humours.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Irritation or itching of nose followed by severe burning of nose. It is due to presence of acute humour which after coming in contact with cold environment causes burning and itching.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Invasion of phlegmatic humour which causes flow of fluid mixed with blood and maggots from the nose. The condition is more common in summer and rainy season.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Bad odour from the nose. Its causes may be nasal polyps, ulcers of nose, injury to the nose, foreign body in the nose, glossitis, dental caries and stomatitis. It may also be a complication of some infectious disease e.g. small pox, measles, syphilis and lymphadenitis. This is due to the upward movement of putrified gases from chest and lungs to nose.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Contusion or crushing of nose due to injury in which the bone and cartilage of nose is broken.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Bleeding from nose. It may be due to congestion, injury, during the Buḥrān (critical phase of disease) of disease. Other causes include presence of acute humours and increased pressure of blood.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of growth of nasal mucosa caused by the accumulation of melancholic blood in the vessels. It is of two types: benign which is soft in consistency and malignant which is hard in consistency. In this condition, there is discharge of fluid mixed with blood, deformity of nose and later disfigurement of face, nasal tone of voice and severe pain.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of reflex movement that occurs when the body tries to eliminate some irritant substance from nose and mouth. It can be caused by two factors i.e. external such as dirt, dust and internal due to involvement of brain e.g. impaired temperament of brain.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Presence of foreign body in the nasal cavity. It can be living e.g. mosquito, flies, etc. and non-living e.g. seeds, peas, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition in which there is severe dryness in the nose after high fever and tuberculosis. It is sometimes due to mucilaginous material which dries because of inspiratory air.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Flow of fluids from brain towards nose. It is due to exposure to hot or cold environment internally and externally. It is of two types Ḥārr (acute) and Bārid (chronic). Acute type is characterized by redness of face, fever, frequent discharge from nose, nasal sound, and irritation of nose. Chronic type is characterized by cold discharge from nose, itching, oedema of face, blockage of nose with nasal sound.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Deviation of nasal septum on either side. It is of two types: Khilqī (congenital) and Iktisābī (acquired).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A state of hypersensitivity induced by exposure to a particular antigen. Unani physicians have described this as a response of medicatrix naturae towards harmful substance. Nasal allergy is marked by irritation of nose and sneezing with discharge. Sometimes there is nasal blockage. On examination the nasal mucosa appears to be inflamed and oedematous.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inflammation of mucous membrane of nose.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Acute inflammation of nasal mucosa.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Chronic inflammation of nasal mucosa.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Chronic inflammation of nasal mucosa marked by wasting of mucous membrane and the glands.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Chronic inflammation of nasal mucosa in which the membrane thickens and swells.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inflammation of paranasal sinuses. This condition may be purulent, non-purulent, acute and chronic. Depending upon the site of involvement it is known as ethmoidal, frontal, maxillary or sphenoidal sinusitis.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is the obstruction of nasal passage caused by viscous humour or fleshy growth or crust of wounds. It is characterized by nasal tone of voice. It can also lead to tinnitus.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inflammation of tongue which may be due to various causes but the most common is the accumulation of viscous fluids on the tongue.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Burning sensation of tongue that may be due to infiltration of acute humour, intake of spicy foods and predominance of heat in brain and stomach.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Severe itching of tongue due to infiltration of sharp humours from the brain or their progression from the stomach.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Scaling of inner surface of mouth and tongue due to accumulation of sharp humours in it.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition where the tongue becomes flaccid, there is increased salivation and patient feels difficulty in speaking.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Complete loss of sense of taste. It is a condition in which the patient can neither differentiate between hot and cold nor sweet and sour taste. It is due to accumulation of fluids in the nerves supplying the tongue.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Impairment of the sense of taste. It is a condition in which the patient feels a bitter taste of everything. It is due to the predominance of yellow bile on the tongue. Sometimes patient feels saline taste due to the preponderance of saline phlegm.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Enlargement of tongue without inflammation because of which tongue usually protrudes out of the mouth. It is due to accumulation of fluids in the tongue. It is of two types: congenital and acquired.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Heaviness of tongue caused by spasm due to dryness, flaccidity, paralysis, meningitis, tongue tie and hard swelling or tumour of the tongue. The condition leads to speech disorders and the affected person suffers from Taghayyur-i-Kalām (inability to pronounce words clearly and with ease).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of hard growth or cyst on the under surface of tongue resembling frog due to which patient cannot speak properly.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Elongated furrow/fissure of the tongue due to dry impaired temperament of head and mouth which causes irritation and burning while eating. It can also be due to the involvement of stomach. Putrified gases from the stomach dry up the tongue causing fissures.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of ulcer found on the external surface of mouth and tongue and spread towards oesophagus and stomach. It is due to accumulation of morbid humours. In this condition the patient feels burning and pain of mouth. Other symptoms that may follow are coated tongue, bad breath, nausea, vomiting, and loss of appetite. When these ulcers spread towards stomach, the patient feels difficulty in swallowing and speaking.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of stomatitis caused by the predominance of sanguine. It is characterized by redness at the site, inflammation and raised temperature, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is a rare type of stomatitis caused by Ṣafrā’ (yellow bile).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of stomatitis caused by salty phlegm. It is characterized by little pain along with whitish discoloration of tongue and excessive salivation.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of stomatitis caused by sharp Muḥtariq Sawdā’ (burnt black bile). It is characterized by black discoloration of tongue and burning sensation.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of stomatitis of children caused by indigestion due to poor quality of milk.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.preferredTerm: Dā’ al-Ḥafr/ Ḥafr al-Asnān wa’l Qalḥ
concepts.transliteration: Da’ al-Hafr/ Hafr al-Asnan wa’l Qalh
aliases: Dā’ al-Ḥafr/ Ḥafr al-Asnān wa’l Qalḥ
concepts.definition: A yellow crust or discolouration of teeth which occurs at the root of the teeth. It can be of different colours e.g. black blue or yellow. It is caused by the deposition of viscous fluid from stomach and intestine in the mouth and teeth. The colour of deposits helps in identifying the predominant humour or causative humour. The crust is sometimes too hard to detach from the teeth.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Protrusion of tongue due to inflammation and swelling or asphyxia.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Dryness of tongue caused by the predominance of Ḥarārat and Yubūsat or sticking of viscous matter on the surface of tongue. It is characterized by the yellowish discoloration, roughness of tongue along with other clinical features of predominance of Ṣafrā’ (yellow bile) or presence of viscous matter on the surface of tongue.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Eruptions of the tongue caused by predominance of Ṣafrā’ (yellow bile) in blood. It causes severe pain and difficulty in eating.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Deep ulcers of mouth commonly found in children. It covers large part of mouth in a short span of time. Its cause is the presence of putrified, irritant, acrid and corrosive humour which infiltrate towards gums from head. This is characterized by foetid breath, burning and pain of mouth, coated tongue, nausea, vomiting, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Involuntary secretion of saliva during sleep. It is caused by hot and wet impaired temperament of stomach.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Foul smell from the mouth due to involvement of stomach. It is caused by the abnormal heat and putrified phlegm in the stomach and characterized by blackish discoloration of teeth. It may also be caused by ulcers of gums and dental caries.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inflammation of soft and hard palate. It is of two types: acute and chronic. Acute type is characterized by redness, pain and swelling of the palate and chronic type is characterized by the presence of oedematous swelling without pain on the palate.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Itching of palate due to heat of brain and stomach along with the infiltration of saline phlegm at the onset of cold and coryza. It is characterized by dryness of nostrils, nausea, vomiting, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inflammation of lips caused by accumulation and predominance of putrified humours

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A cluster of eruptions occurring at the angles of lips after fever or other illnesses. It is caused by the predominance of yellow bile and sanguine.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Ulceration of the papules of lips.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of growth occurring at the lower lip. The shape of this growth is similar to that of a pendunculated polyp or black coloured mulberry or small grape which is blue in colour. It is usually painless. It can spread to both lips and other parts of face. Its cause is the burnt sanguine which accumulates under the skin after rupture of the vessels. It causes aversion of lips outside. It can be benign or malignant in nature.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: White discoloration of lips. It is caused by predominance of phlegmatic fluids and decreased heat of the organs of the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Trembling of lips due to involvement of stomach which is accompanied with nausea. It can also be due to the involvement of nerve which supplies lips. Tremors and facial paralysis are its prodromal symptoms.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Desquamation of lips.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A congenital abnormality of lips in which the upper lip is contracted upwards otherwise it may be due to spasm either evacuative or congestive.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Cracking of lips due to dryness.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inflammation of mouth characterized by the presence of inflammatory patches on the mucous membrane of mouth.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inflammation of mouth marked by ulcers of the mouth.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inflammation of salivary glands.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Pain of the teeth which may be due to 1. hot impaired temperament with swelling 2. cold impaired temperament of teeth or its nerve 3. involvement of stomach/accumulation of putrified humours in the stomach 4. dental caries 5. cold and coryza 6. decay of teeth.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Increase in the level of teeth which can be due to inflammation.When this inflammation is Damawī (sanguineous) in nature the increase is accompanied with pain. When the inflammation is Balghamī (phlegmatic) in nature this increase will be without pain.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Discolouration of teeth caused by the infiltration of morbid humours in the teeth. In this condition colour of teeth becomes blue, violet, or yellow depending on the humour involved.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Grinding of teeth during sleep. The condition usually occurs in children and subsides during adolescence. It is caused by the weakness of muscles of jaws. It is a prodromal symptom of paralysis, facial paralysis or epilepsy as there is an accumulation of fluid in nerves. The condition also occurs due to worm infestation and morbid humours which irritate the brain. It may also occur in severe pain.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Loosening of teeth caused by old age, trauma, acute inflammation of the gums, general debility, anaemia, decay of gums and flaccidity of muscles.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Falling of teeth caused by old age, trauma, anaemia, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Decaying of teeth due to old age, predominance of dryness and putrified humours.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: breaking down of teeth into smaller pieces
concepts.definition: Breaking of teeth.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Cavities formed in the teeth due to the presence of putrified humours. It is an advance stage of dental caries

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Itching or irritation of teeth caused by intake of water mixed with salt, sulphur, etc. and intake of diets or food which produce acrid humours and may cause itching of the whole body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Insensitivity of teeth due to astringent and sour humour which causes roughening of teeth.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Increased sensitivity of teeth due to loss of its upper most covering. In this condition there is increased sensation to cold and hot things.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition in which pain of the teeth is caused by the presence of worms in them. It may damage the roots of teeth.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Its literal meaning is choking. It is an inflammation of external pharynx and larynx or muscles of upper part of oesophagus. The condition leads to difficulty in breathing and swallowing. Depending on the humours involved it is divided into four types i.e. Khunāq Damawī (sanguineous), Ṣafrāwī (bilious), Sawdāwī (melancholic), and Balghamī (phlegmatic).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The inflammation of internal muscles of larynx which in turn leads to change of voice similar to that of a dog.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The inflammation of pharynx.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is the abscess of the posterior part of pharynx.

concepts.definition: Literal meaning of Suqūṭ is “to drop or fall”. In this condition uvula becomes flaccid and hangs loosely in the throat. Patient feels a foreign body sensation in the throat. On examination the elongated uvula can be seen easily. Sometimes it becomes so elongated that the patient feels difficulty in swallowing the food and coughs frequently. It is caused either due to the predominance of blood or phlegm in the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of inflammation of uvula caused by the predominance of Balgham (phlegm). It is characterized by whitish swelling with lesser pain.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of inflammation of uvula caused by the predominance of Sawdā’ (black bile). It is characterized by black, firm swelling along with blackening of palate, tongue and sour taste of mouth.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of inflammation of uvula caused by infiltration of catarrh into uvula.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Scratching of heart. Patient feels severe pain similar to scratching, leading to syncope/fainting.

concepts.definition: A feeling of sinking of the heart due to the involvement of liver. The condition arises because of the congestion of liver with morbid humours.

concepts.definition: A condition caused by an inadequate supply of blood and oxygen to a portion of myocardium.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition that occurs due to loss of supply of blood in a part of muscle of heart or due to occlusion in the coronary artery or its branches.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Formation of thrombus within the blood vessels.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A decrease of flow of blood through coronary arteries.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A slow sinus rhythm with a heart rate of less than 60 per minute.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A fast sinus rhythm with a heart rate of more than 100 per minute. It is seen in fevers, shock, thyrotoxicosis, pericarditis, congenital heart disease, anaemia, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A premature contraction of heart that is independent of the normal rhythm and arises in response to an impulse in some part of the heart other than sino atrial node. It is usually seen in myocardial infarction.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An atrial arrhythmia characterized by rapid randomized contractions of the atrial myocardium causing a totally irregular often rapid ventricular rate.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is seen in young and middle aged persons. Its common complication is mitral valve disease.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition of cardiac arrhythmia in which the atrial contractions are rapid i.e. 200-320 per minute but regular.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition marked by attacks of rapid rate of the heart having sudden onset and cessation.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An abnormally rapid ventricular rhythm up to 150 per minute. This is generated within the ventricle and is most commonly associated with atrio ventricular dissociation.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A combination of junctional tachycardia and atrial tachycardia.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Impairment of conduction in heart excitation often applied specifically to AV node.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Impairment of conduction from the sino atrial node to the atrium resulting in delay or absence of an atrial beat.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A form of heart block in which the block occurs in the atrio ventricular junctional tissues.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Loss of conduction through the atrio ventricular dissociation in which sinus or atrial beat excites the atria.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A form of heart block in which one ventricle is excited before the other because of absence of conduction in one of the branches of bundle of His.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inadequate supply of blood to the body and its organs.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Sudden stoppage of the functions of heart.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inadequate output by the left ventricle.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inadequate right ventricular output.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The backflow of blood from the left ventricle into the left atrium owing to non-closure of the mitral valve.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The backflow of blood from the aorta into the left ventricle owing to non-closure of semi lunar valve.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Condition in which there is persistent high arterial blood pressure.
