concepts.definition: Hypertension occurring without discernible organic cause.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Hypertension due to or associated with a variety of diseases such as renal disorders, disorders of central nervous system, endocrine diseases and vascular diseases.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Severe hypertensive state in which diastolic pressure is more than 120 mm Hg associated with papilloedema and poor prognosis.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The increased blood pressure within the pulmonary circulation.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The hypertension due to or associated with renal disease.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An abnormal persistence of an open lumen in the ductus arteriosus after birth.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The narrowing or stricture of aortic orifice of the heart or of the aorta itself.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Congenital cardiac abnormality in which there is abnormal communication between the ascending aorta and pulmonary artery just above the semilunar valves.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Hardening and thickening of the walls of the arteries.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An extremely common form of arterio sclerosis in which deposits of yellowish plaques containing cholesterol, lipoid material are formed within the inner layer of arteries.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inflammation of arteries.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The inflammation of aorta due to syphilis.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An inflammatory and obliterative disease of the blood vessels of the extremities primarily of the lower extremities occurring chiefly in young men. It leads to ischaemia and gangrene of the tissues.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Its literal meaning is “flowing of blood”. It is a swelling of arteries. It is a dilatation of the arterial wall in which blood and fluids are accumulated. It is a longitudinal and movable dilatation which increases and decreases by the movement of arteries. This movement can be felt by fingers. The blood is usually dark coloured.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An aneurysm in which the sac is formed by the arterial walls and one of it at least is unbroken.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An aneurysm in which sac is formed by the surrounding tissues.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A spindle shaped arterial aneurysm in which the stretching process affects the entire circumference of the artery.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An eccentric, localized distended sac affecting only a part of the circumference of arterial wall.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of aneurysm in which haemorrhage results from the longitudinal splitting of the arterial wall, producing a tear in the intima and establishing communication with the lumen.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The dilatation of arterioles making them swollen.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Diseases of Digestive System

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Abnormal closure of oesophagus. In this disease, lumen of the oesophagus becomes narrow thereby creating difficulty in the passage of liquid diets. It is a type of psychogenic spasm of the muscles of oesophagus.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Injury of oesophagus which can be due to rupture of vessels as a result of trauma or congestion or surgery.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Ulceration of oesophagus due to rupture of pustules, inflammation or bilious vomitus. It can also be due to diversion of catarrhal fluids towards oesophagus.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Irritation of oesophagus due to the reflux of humours accumulated in stomach towards it.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is the inflammation of oesophagus. It is of two types: Ḥārr (acute) and Bārid (chronic). Ḥārr (acute) type is characterized by pain during swallowing along with high grade fever followed by shivering, excessive thirst and pus formation. Bārid (chronic) type is characterized by dysphagia without fever and excessive thirst.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The derangement of the temperament of stomach which can be simple and compound. It can involve humour, organic matter and gases. According to state it is of two types simple and compound. Simple is further subdivided into four types i.e. Ḥārr, Bārid, Yābis and Raṭb. Compound is further divided into Ḥārr Raṭb, Ḥārr Yābis, and Bārid Raṭb. Depending on the humours involved it is of four types i.e. Damawī (sanguineous), Ṣafrāwī (bilious), Sawdāwī (melancholic) and Balghamī (phlegmatic).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Pain of the stomach. It is usually due to material/organic impaired temperament or inflammatory condition of the stomach but in rare cases it can be caused by the simple impaired temperament of the stomach.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Pain of stomach due to the accumulation of flatus/gases.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Pain of stomach due to the preponderance of Dam (blood/sanguine) in the stomach as a result of some inflammatory condition or congestion in it.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Pain of stomach due to the predominance of Ṣafrā’ (yellow bile) in the stomach. It usually occurs in empty stomach.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Pain of stomach due to the predominance of Balgham (phlegm) in the stomach.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Pain of stomach due to the accumulation of Sawdā’ (black bile) in the stomach.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Pain of stomach due to its weakness. Patient suffering from this type of pain usually take light meals. He feels relieved after vomiting.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Weakness of stomach in which patient feels restless after having meals. It is usually accompanied with belching and nausea. Some patients experience loss of appetite. This occurs due to the accumulation of waste materials in the stomach. Some patients may have increased appetite due to the increased gastric secretions. Few patients may have less affinity towards food which is usually psychogenic.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition where food remains in the stomach for a longer time. In this state the temperament and consistency of the food does not change at all so as to accept the function of Quwwat Mughayyira i.e. faculty which helps in the assimilation of food. Some physicians have described this as a functional disorder of stomach and intestine with no structural deformity of the organs.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Incomplete digestion of food leading to the putrefaction of food in the stomach. The reason for the incomplete digestion of food can be food itself either the quantity or the quality or weakness of stomach. It can also be due to some external factors.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Failure of digestion of food and there by its accumulation in the stomach. In this condition undigested food get transformed into decomposed state.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition where food is neither digested nor changed to the decomposed form in the stomach. It remains in the stomach in unchanged form.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition in which the food is altered in decomposed form. Laṭīf (light part) of this form is evacuated by vomiting and the Ghalīẓ (heavy part) is evacuated by purgation. Ibn Sīnā, has described it as a reflex movement of the stomach and intestines to get rid of undigested and decomposed food as seen in food poisoning and cholera. Depending on the humours involved it is classified/into fours types i.e. Damawī (sanguineous), Ṣafrāwī (bilious), Sawdāwī (melancholic) and Balghamī (phlegmatic).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition of severe vomiting and purgation due to intake of contaminated food and drink that causes burning of humours. It leads to severe dehydration and is usually fatal if untreated.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Complete loss of appetite. It can be due to the involvement of humours or defect in the absorptive and assimilative faculties or it can be due to weakness of spleen.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Poor appetite.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Affinity towards spicy foods.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Desire for consuming non-food items e.g. wood, coal, earthen pots, chalk, etc. especially during pregnancy.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A state of increased appetite in which the desire for food is never satisfied. Patient always remains hungry like dogs. This condition arises due to the predominance of coldness in the stomach or by the accumulation of black bile and Balgham Ḥāmiḍ (sour phlegm) in the stomach.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition contrary to Jū‘ al-Kalb in which requirement of food in the body increases but the stomach has no affinity towards food.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A state of increased appetite which may lead to fainting if food is not provided. In this condition stomach has affinity towards the food.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition of excessive thirst that can be due to impaired temperament of any organ or whole body and external factors. External factors can be intake of salty water, hot environment and intake of poisonous drugs.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The inflammation of gastric mucosa. It can be Ḥārr (acute) and Bārid (chronic). Depending on the humours involved Ḥārr is considered to be due to blood and yellow bile and Bārid is due to phlegm and black bile.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: When the inflammation of gastric mucosa is due to the predominance of Dam (sanguine).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: When the inflammation of gastric mucosa is due to the predominance of Ṣafrā’ (yellow bile).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: When the inflammation of gastric mucosa is due to the predominance of Balgham (phlegm).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: When the inflammation of gastric mucosa is due to the predominance of Sawdā’ (black bile).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition where the inflammation of gastric mucosa gets suppurated. Its symptoms include fever with severe rigors and chills, increased burning, loss of appetite, pain aggravating after intake of food. When this condition becomes chronic, the fever subsides and volume of urine decreases.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Ulcers and eruptions of the gastric mucosa. These can be due to infiltration of humour or acid or irritant humours from brain. Its symptoms include mild fever, epigastric pain, foul smell, belching, stomatitis, nausea, vomiting and burning after intake of sour and spicy diet. Presence of blood, pus, mucous in the vomitus and stool may be seen.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Gurgling sound of the intestines due to the presence of Rīḥ (gases).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The distension of abdomen due to the accumulation of Rīḥ (gases) in it.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The sound of expulsion of Rīḥ (gases) through mouth is known as Jushā’. When this condition aggravates it is termed as Kathra al- Jushā’. It is due to Bukhārāt-i-Mi‘da (gastric flatus), hot humours, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The involuntary opening of the mouth is known as Tathā’ub. It is a normal condition but when it occurs frequently and in excess it is known as Kathra al-Tathā’ub.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Tamaṭṭī is a movement of stretching of organs. If it increases it is termed as Kathra al-Tamaṭṭī. It is due to the same reason as Tathā’ub but this is not only confined to the head of the body but extends to other muscles of the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Retention of flatus in the stomach leading to Istisqā’ Ṭablī and colicky pain. The condition is very common in infants.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Reflex action of stomach to get rid of contents of stomach and adjoining organs through mouth. According to the causes it is divided into Qay’ Ṣafrāwī (bilious), Balghamī (phlegmatic), Sawdāwī (melancholic) and ‘Ufūnī.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: vomiting associated with the disease of organ other than stomach
concepts.definition: Vomiting as a result of complication of some other disease.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: vomiting during the crisis period of disease
concepts.definition: Vomiting during the crisis period of diseases.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Vomiting due to worm infestation.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Vomiting of blood from the stomach or oesophagus as a result of collection of blood in the stomach from other organs.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Reflex action of stomach in which nothing is expelled from it through mouth. Its cause lies in the body of the stomach itself.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The act of getting rid of irritant material from the stomach without any movement.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of nausea which always persists.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: coagulation of blood into the stomach
concepts.definition: Coagulation of blood inside the stomach as a result of the rupture of blood vessels. It may cause syncope and tremors.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: coagulation of milk into the stomach
concepts.definition: Coagulation of milk into the stomach due to predominance of coldness. It is characterized by severe irritation and syncope, sweating, cold extremities, spasm, breathlessness, flatulence, nausea, retention of urine and stool. When it is associated with rigors it is considered as a grave condition.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition in which there is weakness and laxity of the muscles of stomach due to repetitive illness, dietary disturbance, use of different drugs, increased nausea and vomiting. In this condition there is weakness of all the faculties of stomach i.e. digestive, absorptive, assimilative and expulsive faculties. The stomach is unable to perform its normal functions. Food is passed out in undigested form with difficulty. Sometimes purgatives and enema is given to patient for defecation.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An involuntary upward movement of the muscles of stomach and diaphragm as a result of the injury and dryness of cardiac end of the stomach. It can also be secondary to other disease of the stomach. Depending on the involvement of humours it is of four types: Fuwāq Damawī (sanguineous), Balghamī (phlegmatic), Ṣafrāwī (bilious) and Sawdāwī (melancholic).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of hiccough that can be due to the retention of Rīḥ (gases) on the cardiac end of stomach, muscles of stomach and oesophagus. It produces spasm and stimulation. The condition usually occurs in infants.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition in which food from the stomach expels from the mouth by vomiting rather than the normal passage through the intestines. This condition is caused due to the duodenal and jejunal ulcers.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of distressing pain of stomach which is usually accompanied with nausea, vertigo and palpitation. It is caused by the irritant material that infiltrates the muscles of stomach.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: feeling of trembling movement of stomach
concepts.definition: The feeling of trembling movement of stomach similar to palpitation. It is caused by Khilṭ Bārid (cold humours) of the stomach either originated from the stomach or infiltrates from other organ. If this movement occurs at the cardiac end of stomach then the patient will feel palpitation and syncope with nausea and retching. In severe cases it involves brain and causes melancholia.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Pain of the cardiac end of stomach which is felt on the anterior chest or upper abdomen.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A severe type of burning sensation of the stomach. It is due to the intake of heavy diet, retention of unaltered fluids or pouring of black bile on the stomach.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of itching/tickling sensation of stomach. It can be due to accumulation of irritant humours in the stomach either originated from it or infiltrated from adjoining area. Another reason for this condition is the presence of eruptions on the gastric mucosa.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition where tonicity of the muscles of stomach is lost. It is due to retention of fluid in the stomach, severe vomiting and diarrhoea. In this condition either the muscles of stomach become flaccid or the ligaments of stomach get flaccid.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A spasmodic condition of stomach caused by Tashannuj Imtilā’ī (congestive spasm) or Tashannuj Istifrāghī (evacuative spasm) of the nerves and ligaments of stomach.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Hardening of gastric area due to the predominance of Sawdā’ (black bile) on the stomach. There is hardness of abdomen on palpation. The condition is usually accompanied with nausea, vomiting, breathlessness, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition in which the size of the stomach becomes small. It may be congenital or acquired . If congenital, there will be gastralgia after intake of large quantity of food right from childhood (gastric hypoplasia). Acquired type can be due to spasm of stomach or inflammation of adjoining organs.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Perforation of stomach due to ulcers which is usually fatal.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A disease in which all the four faculties of liver i.e. Quwwat Hāḍima (digestive power), Quwwat Māsika (assimilative power), Quwwat Jādhiba (absorptive power), Quwwat Dāfi‘a (expulsive power) or some of these faculties become weak. The causes of this type of weakness are the impaired temperament of liver or whole body, diseases of the adjoining organs like gall bladder, spleen, kidneys, uterus, intestines and lungs, diseases of the liver itself e.g. ulcers, congestion, cirrhosis, calculus, obstruction, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The impaired temperament of liver which is exclusively simple in nature and not Māddī (organic). It is of two types; single and compound. Single is subdivided into four type i.e. Sū’ Mizāj Ḥārr, Sū’ Mizāj Bārid, Sū’ Mizāj Raṭb and Sū’ Mizāj Yābis. Compound is again subdivided into four types i.e. Sū’ Mizāj Ḥārr Raṭb, Sū’ Mizāj Ḥārr Yābis, Sū’ Mizāj Bārid Raṭb and Sū’ Mizāj Bārid Yābis. According to the involvement of humours this compound type is subdivided in Ṣafrāwī (bilious), Balghamī (phlegmatic) and Sawdāwī (melancholic).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The obstruction of liver caused by strong Quwwat Jādhiba (absorptive faculty) and weak Quwwat Dāfi‘a (expulsive faculty). These factors lead to the accumulation of viscous humours in the liver which in turn causes the inflammation of liver henceforth the obstruction of liver. As a result of this, patient feels heaviness at the site of liver and becomes weak, pale and breathless. Urine will be colourless and stool becomes soft and colourless.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: collection of gaseous matter into the liver
concepts.definition: Collection of gaseous matter and thereby their condensation inside the liver parenchyma or in the layer covering the liver causes Nafkh-i-Kabid. Condensed vapours could not get dissolved because of their increased amount, obstruction of liver, or thickening of the membrane covering the liver.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Pain of liver which is caused by the morbid temperament and gaseous distension of membrane covering the liver. It can also be due to acute and chronic hepatitis, traumatic injury of liver, pustules, abscess and calculi of liver.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of severe pain of liver which is caused by intake of cold water just after strenuous exercise, empty stomach or after Ḥammām (steam bath).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Swelling of the liver that can be found either on convexity or concavity of the liver or the liver as a whole. This swelling according to the causative agents is of various types: Damawī (sanguineous), Falghamūnī, Ṣafrāwī (bilious), Balghamī (phlegmatic), Ṣulb, Saraṭānī, Ghayr Saraṭānī and Rīḥī.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inflammation of liver due to predominance of Ṣafrā’ (yellow bile). Its symptoms are serrate, rapid and consecutive pulse, pale face, cyanosed tongue, reddish urine, bilious vomitus and hyperpyrexia.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inflammation of liver due to predominance of blood in it. In this condition patient feels severe pain, mild heaviness, excessive thirst, fever, loss of appetite, vomiting, cold and clammy skin of the hands and legs, breathlessness, irritation at the site of liver, pulse bounding, large rapid, consecutive, face congested.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inflammation of liver due to predominance of black bile and is characterised by heaviness, loss of appetite, dark face, dry tongue and blackish urine.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inflammation of liver due to predominance of phlegm in it and characterised by heaviness, oedematous face and slow feeble pulse.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inflammation of liver marked by severe pain with loss of appetite.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Injury of liver in which it becomes swollen and in severe cases bleeding occurs through vomiting and purgation.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A very rare condition in which eruptions appear on the surface of liver. Its cause is the accumulation of Ṣafrā’ (yellow bile) on its surface which causes irritation and burning.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.preferredTerm: Taṣaghghur al-Kabid/ Ṣughār al-Kabid/ Ḍumūr al-Kabid
concepts.transliteration: Tasaghghur al-Kabid/ Sughar al-Kabid/ Dumur al-Kabid
aliases: Taṣaghghur al-Kabid/ Ṣughār al-Kabid/ Ḍumūr al-Kabid
تصغر الكبد/ صغار الكبد/ ضمور الكبد
concepts.definition: A condition in which the size of the liver decreases. Due to this condition liver is unable to perform its metabolic functions and the diet or food which reaches there from stomach remains as it is and causes pain due to distension and diarrhoea. This condition can be congenital (hepatic hypoplasia) as well as acquired. The patients suffering from this condition are diagnosed by the shortening of the fingers and thinning of the blood vessels.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition in which the size of liver increases without inflammation. It does not affect the functions of the liver. This condition usually occurs in tropical countries where there is an increased incidence of malaria. It is sometimes associated with phthisis, tuberculosis and diabetes.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The feeling of trembling movement of the liver due to obstruction of vessels passing through porta hepatis in the liver. In this condition, the liver becomes distended causing severe pain.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Tearing of liver parenchyma and its vessels. In mild cases patient survives but in severe cases it is usually fatal. Bleeding occurs through urine and purgation.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The consolidation of liver which results after the chronic inflammation of liver and thereby fibrosis. This fibrotic area pressurises porta hepatis and vessels of liver making it difficult for the flow of blood and bile. Due to this liver becomes weak. The patient of this condition suffers from haematemesis and rectal bleeding.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An abscess of liver resulting from its acute inflammation. When this inflammation does not subside, it gets suppurated. It is usually accompanied with loss of appetite, restlessness, high fever, pain, redness of face and eyes and irritation of liver.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition in which calculi are formed within the liver. In this condition patient suffers from vomiting after complete digestion of food, irritation, pain and heaviness at the site of liver.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Derangement of the temperament of liver which makes it unable to form normal blood. This condition leads to ascites. The condition is characterized by changes in the body colour, swelling of eyes and body, impaired digestion, altered appetite, irregular bowels, disturbed sleep, increased flatulence, decreased healing process and fatigue. It is a serious humoral disease which is difficult to treat. This disease is caused by the impaired function of liver either of the liver itself or due to association with other diseases.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Chronic abnormality of blood which affects the nutrition of the skin and produces various changes in it e.g. pigmentation, discolouration, melasma, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Anaemia

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Collection of fluid in the organs and their cavities.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of swelling of the body due to cachexia. It is a generalized and massive oedema of the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Collection of condensed gases or mixed fluid in the abdominal cavity. It is caused due to impaired digestive function of the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Collection of fluid in the peritoneal cavity. It is due to increased transudation from portal vein.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Yellow discoloration of eyes and skin. It is due to the accumulation of uninfected yellow bile towards skin. Excessive bile in the body can be due to increased production of bile in the liver for any reason or obstruction in the passage of bile from the gall bladder at any point from liver to intestines. It is characterized by fever, nausea, bilious vomiting, heaviness at the site of liver, excessive thirst, foetid breath, constipation. According to causes it is subdivided into different types: Yarqān Suddī (obstructive jaundice), Yarqān Waramī (hepatitis jaundice), Yarqān Ghalayānī (haemolytic jaundice), Yarqān Sammī (epidemic jaundice), Yarqān Buḥrānī (critical jaundice).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Blackish discoloration of the skin. It is due to the impaired function of spleen. It is characterized by blackish discolouration of urine and stool, tightening of the skin and abdomen, heaviness of the abdomen and sometimes discoloration of sweat.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Impaired temperament of spleen like other organs. It can be simple as well as compound. Simple type can be subdivided into Ḥārr, Bārid, Yābis, and Raṭb. Compound can be Ḥārr Yābis, Ḥārr Raṭb, Bārid Yābis, and Bārid Raṭb. When this involves humour it is divided into Damawī (sanguineous), Ṣafrāwī (bilious), Balghamī (phlegmatic) and Sawdāwī (melancholic).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inflammation and consolidation of spleen. According to Ibn Sina inflammation rarely occurs in spleen but when the inflammation occurs and gets prolonged it causes consolidation of spleen. According to the involvement of humours it is divided into Damawī (sanguineous), Balghamī (phlegmatic) and Ṣafrāwī (bilious). The symptoms are the same as in case of humoral predominance.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Enlargement of spleen. According to Hippocrates, spleen becomes palpable when the size of spleen increases by double or triple. As a result of this enlargement, bad chyme is produced from the spleen.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Formation of pus in the spleen. This condition comes after the inflammation of spleen. It is characterized by severe pain and irritation at the site of spleen.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: accumulation of gases in the spleen
concepts.definition: Accumulation of gases in the spleen and its covering layer formed due to the cold impaired temperament and excessive black bile. It causes pain and heaviness on the left hypochondriac region.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Weakness of the faculties of spleen which can be due to splenic abscess, inflammation and wounds. If Quwwat Jādhiba (absorptive faculty) is weak it is characterized by loss of appetite, blackening of sclera, blackish discoloration of face and black jaundice.If it is due to the weakness of Quwwat Māsika (assimilative faculty), excretion of undigested black bile from spleen causes nausea, bilious vomiting and bilious purgation.If it is due to the weakness of Quwwat Hāḍima (digestive faculty), there may be false appetite or canine appetite, melancholic purgation, elephantiasis and varicose veins. If it is due to weakness of Quwwat Dāfi‘a (expulsive faculty) there will be splenitis, splenomegaly and infected black bile may cause melancholic fever.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is the obstruction within spleen that can be of three types according to the cause i.e. Sudda Rīḥī (gaseous obstruction), Sudda Khilṭī (humoral obstruction) and Sudda Waramī (inflammatory obstruction). Sudda Khilṭī causes heaviness without inflammatory signs. Sudda Rīḥī causes severe distension but no heaviness. Sudda Waramī causes inflammatory signs and symptoms.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Presence of calculus in spleen which is a rare condition. It is characterized by pain of piercing nature and irritation in spleen.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Pain in the spleen that can be due to impaired temperament of spleen, injury and inflammation of spleen. It is usually associated with splenomegaly.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: This includes acute inflammation, congestion, haemorrhage, pancreatomegaly, carcinoma, decrease in the size or weakness, consolidation, softening, impaired structure, tumour and calculi.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition where food is passed on towards intestines in undigested form. The condition is due to the loss of assimilative power of intestine.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The passage of loose stools. It can be due to the involvement of contaminated food, air and diseased organs.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of Ishāl that can be due to decreased intake of food, excessive intake of food unwillingly. It can also be caused by the altered quality of food, sternuous exercise after meals, excessive intake of water after meals and intake of infected and irritant foods.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of loose stools that occur due to the exposure of hot and cold climate or by the polluted air.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Passage of pus with loose stools due to the rupture of abscesses of any internal organs e.g. stomach, liver, etc. Sometimes this pus comes from the intestinal ulcers.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Passage of blood with loose stool. When this blood comes from liver it is known as Dhūsanṭāriya Kabidī and if it comes from intestines it is known as Dhūsanṭāriya Mi‘wī.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The cause of this type of loose stools is the infiltration of Nazla (catarrhal fluids) towards the stomach from the brain due to its cold or hot impaired temperament.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The passage of chylous stools due to the weakness, obstruction and inflammation of liver and mesenteries.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: diarrhoea similar to raw meat washings due to the involvement of liver
concepts.definition: The passage of loose stools similar to wash water of meat due to the weakness of the Quwwat Hāḍima (digestive faculty) of the liver because of abnormal Burūdat (coldness).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Passing of bilious loose stools due to hot impaired temperament of liver. The condition should not be checked immediately as this will prove fatal or may lead to ascites.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Passage of pus in the loose stools due to inflammation and abscess of liver.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: diarrhoea similar to curdled milk due to the involvement of liver
concepts.definition: Passage of sediments in loose stools due to the rupture of liver abscess.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: diarrhoea due to bilious fever or hectic fever
concepts.definition: Passage of bilious loose stools due to the involvement of gall bladder.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: diarrhoea due to the involvement of spleen
concepts.definition: Passage of loose stools due to the involvement of spleen.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Passage of loose stools due to the predominance of Ruṭūbat (wetness) in the intestines.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: diarrhoea due to the eruptions of intestine
concepts.definition: Passing of loose stools due to the intestinal eruptions.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Passing of loose stools due to the predominance of Ṣafrā’ (yellow bile) in the intestines.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Passing of loose stools due to the predominance of Sawdā’ (black bile) in the intestines.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Infants passing loose stools during their teething period. This is due to inflammation of gums and thereby mixing of inflammatory exudates in the milk. This is the diversion of medicatrix naturae towards the growth of teeth, because of which digestive functions are affected.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Passage of loose stools because of the involvement of stomach.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Passing of loose stools with blood due to abrasion of intestines.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Passing of loose stools with mucous due to abrasion of intestines.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: diarrhoea mixed with thin or thick scales due to abrasion of intestine
concepts.definition: Passing of loose stools with scraps due to abrasion of intestines.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Passing of loose stools with pus due to abrasion of intestines.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Passing of loose stools with froth due to the abrasion of intestines.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Passing of loose stools with yellow bile due to the abrasion of intestines.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: When the sensitivity of intestine is increased or retentive power is lost, there is involuntary passage of loose stools. The condition may occur due to weakness of the nerves supplying the intestines or accumulation of melancholic humours.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Dharab is a chronic illness in which there are continuous loose stools. Khilfa is a condition in which food does not stay in the stomach but is passed undigested from the stomach in one and more than one bowel.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Saḥj is the abrasion of the inner most layer of intestine. It can be due to: 1. Infiltration of yellow bile, saline phlegm and black bile into intestines. 2. Passage of hard stools from the intestines. 3. Use of irritant or erosive drugs. 4. Use of drastic purgatives. Depending on the involvement of humours it is divided into Damawī (Sanguineous), Ṣafrāwī (bilious), Sawdāwī (melancholic) and Balghamī (phlegmatic).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Passing of blood mixed with stools. It can be due to congestion, injury, inflammation or rupture of vessels of liver. In this condition patient usually feels no pain or mild pain with fresh bleeding. In this bleeding occurs in episodes. Patient becomes emaciated after sometime. It is also known as Ishāl Kabidī.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: blood with diarrhoea due to involvement of intestine
concepts.definition: It is the passing of blood mixed stools from the intestines due to its ulceration. This condition is usually very painful. Patient becomes emaciated after a long time. It is also known as Ishāl Mi‘wī.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An abnormal movement of rectum in which there is frequent passage of stools with or without blood associated with tenesmus and spasm of the intestine leading to the rupture of intestinal blood vessels. In this condition there is a passage of mucous with blood in stool. It is of two types: 1. Zaḥīr Kādhib / Bāṭil: An abnormal movement of the rectum to expel that dry stool which is accumulated in the sigmoid colon of small intestine. 2. Zaḥīr Ṣādiq: An abnormal movement of rectum to expel the infiltrated yellow bile and saline phlegm from it. Inflammation of rectum is also one of the causes of this abnormal movement. As per the causative factor it is divided into Ṣafrāwī (bilious), Balghamī (phlegmatic) and Riḥī.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of dysentery that is caused by the inflammation of rectum.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of dysentery that is caused by the polluted air or water.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of dysentery that is caused as a result of the injury of the rectum.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of dysentery that usually occurs in infants due to cold and sometimes due to the predominance of Ṣafrā’ ( yellow bile).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Gripping pain of intestines which usually occurs in small intestine. The intensity of pain is less than that of colic. It can be due to inflammation, condensed gases, yellow bile, phlegm, black bile, dry stool, worm infestation and critical condition of the body. According to causes it is classified into Maghṣ Ṣafrāwī (bilious tenesmus), Maghṣ Sawdāwī (melancholic tenesmus), Maghṣ Balghamī (phlegmatic tenesmus), Maghṣ Rīḥī (gaseous tenesmus), Maghṣ Waramī (inflammatory tenesmus), Maghṣ Thuflī (tenesmus due to dry stool), Maghṣ Dīdānī (helmenthic tenesmus) and Maghṣ Buḥrānī (tenesmus during crisis of disease).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Gripping pain of small intestines that occurs in infants. It is due to the weakness of stomach, excessive intake of milk or decrease in the quality of milk which lead to excessive production of gases. The accumulation of these gases in the intestines causes tension and pain.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Nafkh is the distension of stomach with gases. Qarāqir is the rumbling noise caused by the propulsion of gas through the intestines. Both conditions are due to excessive production of gases because of the impaired digestive function.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of severe pain of colon caused by intestinal obstruction. The obstruction can be in the form of gases, dry faecal matter or inflammation, etc. According to the causes and site of pain it is classified into many types.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: intestinal colic due to inflammation of colon
concepts.definition: When the cause of obstruction is inflammation of the intestines. Depending on the involvement of humours, it is divided into Qūlanj Waramī Damawī (sanguineous), Qūlanj Waramī Balghamī (phlegmatic), Qūlanj Waramī Ṣafrāwī (bilious) and Qūlanj Waramī Sawdāwī (melancholic).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of colic in which the intestinal obstruction is caused by condensed gases.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of colic caused by axial rotation of the loops of the intestines.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Colic due to intestinal obstruction caused by the herniation of intestine.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: intestinal colic due to worm infestation
concepts.definition: Colic due to worm infestation.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: In this type of colic, the intestinal obstruction is due to dried faecal matter.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The most common type of colic in which intestinal obstruction is caused by viscous phlegmatic humour.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of colic that occurs in grief, fear, exposure to cold environment, intake of ice and sometimes secondary to other diseases e.g. hysteria.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of colic that occurs because of lead poisoning.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of colic that occurs because of the inflammation and obstruction of appendix.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of colic that is caused by the obstruction of hepatic duct due to calculi.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of colic that is caused by the inflammation and obstruction of gall bladder.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of colic that is caused by the obstruction of kidneys with calculi.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of colic that is due to the spasm of stomach.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of colic due to copper poisoning.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of colic caused by viscous humour or gases. This is the worst and most painful of all types. When it gets stabilized it leads to sudden death.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of colic that affects population at large.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Colic associated with other diseases.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Severe colicky pain of small intestine caused by its obstruction due to inflammation, dry stool etc. According to Hippocrates the meaning of Īlā’ūs is “God Forbid”. It is an acute and severe condition when the patient has projectile vomiting with gastrointestinal contents. Sometimes it is preceded by Qūlanj and vice versa.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)
