concepts.definition: An infectious disease which transmits sexually. It is of two types: congenital and acquired. It is caused by specific causative organism. It is characterized by the presence of hard ulcer on the skin.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.preferredTerm: Wabāl Warāthī /Khilqī Ātshak / Al-Afranjī al-Warāthī / Mawrūthī Ātshak
concepts.transliteration: Wabal Warathi /Khilqi Atshak / Al-Afranji al-Warathi / Mawruthi Atshak
aliases: Wabāl Warāthī /Khilqī Ātshak / Al-Afranjī al-Warāthī / Mawrūthī Ātshak
وبال وراثي / خلقي آتشك / الافرنجي الوراثي / موروثي آتشك
concepts.definition: A type of syphilis that occurs in the intra uterine life through mother. It is an infectious disease.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of sexually transmitted disease which is highly infectious in nature. Infection is usually localized on the genitalia of both male and female. Its infection does not spread in the blood like syphilis and does not produce any complication.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is the inflammation of uterus, affecting its different parts.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is a condition of painful menstruation.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is a condition of decreased blood flow during menstrual period.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Diseases of Skin and Cosmetology

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: White discolouration of the skin which can appear anywhere in the body but mostly occurs on hands and feet. When it involves most of the body’s skin it is known as Baraṣ Muntashir (extensive vitiligo). It is caused by the weakness of Quwwat Mughayyira (transformative faculty), cold impaired temperament of organs or it may be congenital.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Black discoloration of the skin with scaling. The skin becomes rough. It is due to the accumulation of black bile under the skin.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Slight white discolouration associated with fine scaling of the skin. Its causes are the same as that of Baraṣ but mild in severity that is why it is confined only to the skin. It is also considered to be an infection of the skin which is caused by some organism and can spread to others by clothes.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Blackish discoloration of the skin. It is due to predominance of burnt yellow bile.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Bluish, black or red spots united to form a patch on the face. It is due to burnt blood, collected under the skin. It is most commonly seen on cheeks, forehead, upper lips, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Black coloured spots on the body due to the collection of black bile under the skin.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Reddish spot on the skin which is usually congenital.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Black coloured circular spots slightly raised from the surface of the skin. These are caused by the predominance of burnt black bile.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Greenish or blackish discolouration of the skin due to the accumulation of blood beneath it after trauma.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Marks on the skin formed by tattooing.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Marks left after the healing of a wound or other morbid process.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Scars of the eruptions of small pox.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An ugly extensive red discolouration of the skin which is commonly seen on face and extremities. It mostly occurs in winter season and often accompanied with ulcers.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Pigmentation of skin due to following causes: 1. Deviation of waste humours towards skin, 2. Predominance of waste materials in blood such as in Jaundice, 3. Weakness of the organs e.g. liver, spleen, 4. Exposure to sun and cold climate, 5. Irregularities in food intake e.g. excessive use of Carum carvi and fruit of Ptychotis ajowan make the skin pale, 6. Intake of stagnant water, 7. Chronic illness, increased sexual activity and excessive grief.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition in which there is scaling of skin due to predominance of black bile. Scales may be of different size and colour. This term was initially used by Rhazes for psoriasis which was specifically characterised by copious scaling of silvery white scales.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.preferredTerm: Ḥazāz-o-Ibriyya/ Bafā/ Hubayrā/ Qishr al-Ra’s/ Ḥibriyya
concepts.transliteration: Hazaz-o-Ibriyya/ Bafa/ Hubayra/ Qishr al-Ra’s/ Hibriyya
aliases: Ḥazāz-o-Ibriyya/ Bafā/ Hubayrā/ Qishr al-Ra’s/ Ḥibriyya
concepts.definition: Scaling of the skin of scalp which sheds without ulcers. When the intensity of waste humour increases the ulceration of skin occurs. It is caused by saline phlegm or the blood mixed with black bile. Sometimes it occurs secondary to other diseases in the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Its literal meaning is fox’s disease. It is the falling of hair in the form of patches from scalp, beard and eyebrows. It is termed as Dā’al-Tha‘lab, because the condition of scalp resembles with the farm that has been ravaged by foxes. Its causes may be acrid phlegm, viscid and morbid sanguineous matter, consumption of spicy and salty diets, burnt blood and nervine weakness.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: alopecia with loss of a layer of skin
concepts.definition: Its literal meaning is “snake’s disease”. The snakes have a peculiar phenomenon of shedding the entire skin on a cyclical basis i.e moulting. There is scaling of skin with loss of hair in this disease also, hence the name.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Falling of hair that can be due to weakness of Quwwat Nāmiya (growing faculty) or dilatation of the hair follicles. It may also be due to nutritional deficiencies, laxity of skin, dryness, predominance of viscous and morbid humours, ulcers of scalp and alopecia.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: thinning of scalp skin with hair loss
concepts.definition: A type of alopecia in which the skin of scalp resembles with the skin of ostrich with plucked feathers. It is associated with hair fall.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Falling of hair from the anterior portion of the scalp.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The greying of scalp hair generally because of ageing. It is due to nutritional deficiencies and predominance of Burūdat (coldness) in the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The lengthening of hair, which can be done by using drugs that have strong astringent and absorptive action.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: To grow or regrow hair in cases of localised or generalised alopecia.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Removal of hair.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Curling of hair for cosmetic purposes.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: To make the hair thin.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Straightening of hair.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Splitting of the hair due to the predominance of dryness in the body and poor nutrition.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition in which there is foul smell of hair. Whenever there is an increase in the nutrition of hair, sebaceous glands which are situated beneath the hair become hyperactive. As a result of this hyperactivity, they produce large amount of sebum which leads to foul smell. Apart from this, it is also caused by the diversion of matter from the body towards the scalp.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition in which lice or its eggs are produced as a result of unhygienic conditions of hair.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: a special kind of lice that remain firmly attached to the hair root
concepts.definition: A specific type of lice which is tightly attached to the hair follicles and cannot be seperated easily until warm water is poured on it.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition in which the nails become white like mica. It is due to the excessive dryness in the body and anaemia. In this condition the nails become brittle and break down easily.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Whitening of nails due to varied reasons.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Dotted discolouration of nails. In this condition there is appearance of dots of different colours on nails.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition where nails become thick, weak and brittle that break into pieces.The process usually begins at the distal nail edge and then involves the whole nail causing discolouration, ridging and black discolouration. It is due to accumulation of black bile.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Ridging of nails due to the predominance of black bile and dryness.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A deformity of nails in which the shape of nails becomes curved or hooked. This condition appears when there is regrowth of nail after being primarily destroyed by some trauma or impairedness. Repeated contact with hard objects causes this deformity of nails.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Complete dettachment of the nails due to trauma.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Detachment of the nails due to accumulation of fluid in the nail bed.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Accumulation of blood in the nail bed due to vascular rupture.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Yellowish discoloration of nails due to anaemia and predominance of bile in the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Crushing of nails due to trauma.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Excessive sweating without any apparent cause i.e. climatic conditions or physical exertion. The condition however does not cause weakness of the body. It is caused either by the increase in nutrition or weakness of the Quwwat Māsika (retentive faculty) and laxity of the skin pores.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Foul smelling sweat from palm, sole, axilla and groin region due to the disturbance in the function of sweat producing glands or unhygienic conditions.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition in which there is discharge of sanguineous fluid resembling the colour of washed water of meat. It is due to the increase in sharpness of blood due to the mixing of yellow bile and weakness of the Quwwat Māsika (retentive faculty) of the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Cracking of extrimities and face. The condition occurs due to the predominance of dryness in the body which can be due to external factors i.e. environmental conditions or internal factors.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Ulcers at the angle of mouth which are caused by the infiltration of saline phlegmatic humour from the head.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: Cracking of surrounding areas of nails
concepts.definition: It is a condition in which surrounding areas of nails get cracked.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Increase in the thickness of the skin due to the predominance of black bile and its infiltration towards skin. The condition may or may not be associated with itching.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Cracking of feet or heels occuring due to friction by woollen clothes and socks.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: Scaling of the skin of forehead.
concepts.definition: Scaling of the skin of forehead.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Abrupt eruptions of the skin which are reddish in colour with raised margins cause severe itching of the body. They are caused by hot and acute humours which are produced by the disturbance of metabolism, indigestion, constipation, frequent intake of infected and improper diets which are not easily digestible, irregular menstruation, intake of alcohol. It is more prevalent in women than men. It is of two types: Sharā Damawī (sanguineous urticaria) and Sharā Balghamī (phlegmatic urticaria).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of urticaria which occurs during night time only. In cold climate as in night when the temperature decreases the pores of the skin get closed and the vapours which come out through these pores remain collected under the skin, resulting in urticaria.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Prickly eruptions resembling that of Jowār (Sorghum vulgare) and Bājra (Eleusine coracana) and are spread all over the skin. The eruptions mostly occur in hot climate and countries and hot temperament individuals. Mostly, it affects those parts of the body where there is an accumulation of excessive sweat. These are due to closing of pores and caused by collection of acute humours under the skin.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of roughness or scaly skin which is black or red in colour. It is caused by acrid pungent fluid mixed with black bile which is more viscous than the humour responsible for scabies.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An acute type of roughness of skin.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of Qūbā which permeates deep in the skin and has bad prognosis.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A chronic type of roughness of skin in which there is sloughing of the skin like that of scales of fish. Its causes are similar to that of alopecia.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A bad type of Qūbā (ringworm) which is spreading and migrating in nature.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A bad type of Qūbā (ringworm) which is stationary in nature.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An acute infection of the nail bed. It is accompanied with severe pain, distension, leading to falling off nail and fever. It is caused by predominance of blood and blood mixed with yellow bile. Sometimes it is caused by general weakness of the body, weakness of liver, anaemia and lymphadenitis.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Small red papules which cause severe itching. Sometimes Jarab gets infected and pustules are formed. These are most commonly found in hands and between fingers but may spread to other areas of the body. It is caused by specific organism, Dūd-i-Jarab (animalcule) which resembles lice. For the first time they were identified by Unani Physician, Ṭabrī. It is divided into three types as per the involvement of humours i.e. Jarab Ṣafrāwī, Sawdāwī and Balghamī.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Itching of the body. It starts from calf muscles and is due to the disturbance in digestion and nutritional deficiencies.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of itching mostly found in older people. In such people, there is reduction of the innate heat of the body and increased production of saline phlegm. Weakness of the skin closes the pores and this saline phlegm cause severe itching.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A variant infection involving head, face and hair follicles. This is characterized by the appearance of one or more papule at the root of hair follicle which gets encrusted and later takes the shape of ulcer.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An ulcerated form of Sa‘fa from which there is continuous discharge of purulent fluid. It is more commonly seen in children. It is caused by viscous, putrified, irritant and bad humours which causes swelling and ulceration of skin.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A dry form of Sa‘fa in which there is white scaling of skin. It is caused by black bile mixed with pungent humour which sharpens the nature of the disease.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of Sa‘fa Raṭba. In this condition, the scalp becomes honey comb like in appearance with small openings which are filled with fluid. It is accompanied with hair loss.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of Sa‘fa. Its literal meaning is “tip of needle”. The papules are similar to tip of needle with swelling of the root of hair follicle from which there is discharge of fluid mixed with blood.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of Sa‘fa which resembles fig in appearance. There is round ulcerated portion within the papules similar to that of fig.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of Sa‘fa which occurs in semi lunar shape and are red in colour.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A bad and chronic type of Sa‘fa which is caused by morbid humours.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: ulceration of the scalp hair roots with intense redness
concepts.definition: A red coloured Sa‘fa involving the skin of scalp. It is painful and appears after shaving the head. According to Galen, if it is suppurated, it cannot be treated.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: spasm of skin of the forehead with itching and redness
concepts.definition: Spasm of the skin of forehead which causes wrinkles on the forehead. It is more commonly seen in winter season. It is characterized by burning and itching.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Injury of the toe due to stumbling on the road.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Swelling and itching of the fingers in winter season. It commonly occurs in individuals having bilious temperament. During winter season the skin pores are closed and there is thickening of skin due to which morbid material get accumulated in the skin of fingers.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Itching of the fingers.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An infection caused by the continous dampening in between the fingers.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A foul smell of axilla and groin region. It is caused by the putrefaction of the humours of body. It is also due to strenuous physical activity especially after over indulgence in sex.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Foul smell in the scalp due to hypersecretion and putrefaction of the sebaceous glands. The condition is more commonly seen in children because of the presence of considerable amount of fluid in them. In older people this condition arises due to the decrease in the innate energy of the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: خصر و تصقيع/ فساد الاطراف بالبرد
concepts.definition: In countries that have a cold climate there is thickening of the skin of hand, feet, face which sometimes get resolved and sometimes gets ulcerated and detaches after developing gangrene.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Hard eruptions on the surface of the skin. If the edges of these eruptions are circular, then these are known as Masāmīr. If the edges are slanting, these are known as Qurūn. These are produced by the predominance of viscous phlegm.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.preferredTerm: Buthūr Labaniyya/ Ḥabb al-Shabāb/ Buthūr Duhniyya/ Al-Ghudd al-Shā’i‘
concepts.transliteration: Buthur Labaniyya/ Habb al-Shabab/ Buthur Duhniyya/ Al-Ghudd al-Sha’i‘
aliases: Buthūr Labaniyya/ Ḥabb al-Shabāb/ Buthūr Duhniyya/ Al-Ghudd al-Shā’i‘
بثور لبنيہ / حب الشباب /بثور دہنیہ /الغد الشائع
concepts.definition: Sometimes there is an appearance of white papules on face and nose accompanied by discharge of viscous fluids from them.These are mostly due to the inflammation of hair follicles and their accompanying sebaceous glands in young people.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Fevers

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is the abnormal heating of the body which after reaching the heart from any part of the body spreads to other organs through vessels. This abnormal heating interferes with the vital faculties of the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of fever which lasts only for few days. It is a transient and short term fever.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of fever that occurs due to severe apprehension.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of fever that occurs due to fear and fright as these gestures aggravates the heat of the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of fever that occurs due to profound anxiety.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of fever that occurs due to excessive anger. The fever is characterized by red swollen face, red congested eyes, high pulse volume, red urine and may cause burning.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of fever that occurs due to excessive happiness and joy.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of transient fever that occurs due to sleep deprivation. This is accompanied with sunken eyes, puffy eyelids, palor face, swollen body, low volume pulse.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of transient fever that occurs due to excessive physical exertion and fatigue.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of transient fever that occurs due to excessive loss of fluids because of loose motions. In this type of fever patient will give history of loose motion or use of any drug which causes loose motion.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of transient fever that occurs due to excessive pain.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of transient fever that occurs due to fainting and coma.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of fever that occurs due to excessive thirst over a long time.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of fever that occurs due to excessive starvation over a long time. This is characterized by low feeble pulse.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: Ephemeral fever due to occlusion of blood vessels
concepts.definition: A type of transient fever that occurs due to obstruction of blood vessels. This is the only type of transient fever which can last up to three days and can transform into Ḥummā ‘Ufūnī i.e. infectious fever. The temperature in this type is higher than any other fever, pulse rate becomes faster, urine become dark.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of transient fever that occurs due to dyspepsia and indigestion. In this there is increased sore eructation.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of fever that results due to ulcers, wounds, injuries, boils, abscesses, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: Ephemeral fever due to heat stroke
concepts.definition: A type of transient fever that results from the long exposure to sun or travelling under the sun. In this the eyes become congested, pulse small and fast.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: ephemeral fever due to lack of perspiration
concepts.definition: A type of transient fever caused by the closure of the skin pores due to cold environment, bathing with excessively cold water or water in which astringent drugs are added e.g. alum. In this condition, the skin becomes thickened, face and eyes are swollen, pulse becomes rapid, and urine becomes concentrated and yellow in colour.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of transient fever that occurs due to the intake of pure alcohol. In this condition eyes and face become congested and there will be burning at the site of liver.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of fever that occurs due to the intake of hot diets rich in spices.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: ephemeral fever due to certain drugs
concepts.definition: A type of fever that occurs due to the intake of drugs of hot temperament.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: ephemeral fever due to discontinuing abstinence from bathing
concepts.definition: A type of transient fever that occurs due to closure of skin pores by dirt and dust because of abstinence from bathing.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of fever that occurs due to cold and coryza.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of fever that occurs due to dysentery.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Transient fever due to exposure to extreme heat.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.preferredTerm: Ḥummā al-Yawm Nawmiyya/ Ḥummā al-Yawm Rāḥiyya
concepts.transliteration: Humma al-Yawm Nawmiyya/ Humma al-Yawm Rahiyya
aliases: Ḥummā al-Yawm Nawmiyya/ Ḥummā al-Yawm Rāḥiyya
حمیٰ اليوم نوميہ/ حمیٰ اليوم راحيہ
concepts.definition: This type of transient fever occurs due to prolonged sleep. The patient will give a history of excessive sleep and less physical exertion. Pulse will be voluminous.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: This occurs due to trauma or injury of the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: This type of fever occurs due to the accumulation of bad humours in the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: ephemeral fever due to excessive evacuation
concepts.definition: Transient fever due to excessive evacuation.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A specific type of fever which gradually destroys the fluids and weakens the organs of the body and causes weight loss.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of fever in which the temperature of the humours of body usually rises because of putrefaction. From here it goes towards heart and then spreads to other organs of the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The abnormal changes occurring in the humours and body due to obnoxious substances that affect their normal functioning. Sometimes these changes occur inside the vessels i.e. Dākhil al-‘Urūq and when these changes occur outside the vessels these are known as Khārij al-‘Urūq.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: When the putrefaction of the humours occurs inside the vessels i.e. Dākhil al-‘Urūq then the fever remains continuous.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: When the putrefaction of the humours occurs outside the vessels i.e. Khārij al-‘Urūq then it results in the fever of non-continuous nature.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of fever that occurs due to the predominance of Ṣafrā’ (yellow bile) in the body. It is of three types i.e. Ghibb Dā’ira, Ghibb Lāzima and Ghibb Muḥarriqa.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: When the putrefaction of yellow bile occurs outside the vessels then the attack of fever occurs after three days or approximately 48 hours. The attack usually starts with rigors and chills. It is accompanied with headache, excessive thirst, restlessness, bilious vomiting and sometimes, bilious diarrhoea. Pulse in the initial stage is irregular and later on, it becomes rapid and strong and urine is reddish and sharp smelling. This fever subsides with sweating and the attack of fever is of short duration usually 4-6 hours and sometimes it extends upto 12 hours. This type of fever has got good prognosis similar to ephemeral fever.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: When the putrefaction of Ṣafrā’ (yellow bile) occurs within the vessels then the fever is continuous in nature and lasts for 5-14 days. But meanwhile there is relief in symptoms for few hours. The fever is usually high with or without rigors and chills. Before the onset of fever patient feels nausea and restlessness. In this stage the face and eyes of the patient becomes red and congested, experiences excessive thirst, bilious vomiting, pulse rapid, urine red, scanty. This fever subsides in the form of Buḥrān.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: When the fever and its related symptom are more severe as compared to tertian fever. In this condition, the patient’s tongue becomes rough, black, fever is continuous in nature, and there is restlessness, confusion, excessive thirst and bilious vomiting. This type of fever occurs mostly in children and young people.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of septic phlegmatic fever whose attacks occur on consecutive days. This starts with severe rigors and chills. Temperature is not very high. Pulse is low and irregular accompanied with oedematous body, phlegmatic vomiting, diarrhoea and viscous urine. It affects persons with phlegmatic temperament i.e. children and older people.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The attack of septic phlegmatic fever occurs twice in a day.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: When there is involvement of yellow bile in phlegm the symptoms of fever are more severe.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: In this condition there is no rigor and chills. The symptoms are more or less same as that of Ḥummā Muwāẓiba.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of septic melancholic fever in which subsequent attack occurs every four day. This is a type of intermittent fever because the putrefaction of black bile occurs outside the vessels. The fever occurs mostly in summer season. The fever starts with mild rigors and chills and lasts for 24 hours. It is associated with joint pain, there is involvement of spleen, hardness of pulse and excessive thirst.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of fever that occurs when there is putrefaction of black bile inside the vessels. In this type, fever is continuous, but on the fourth day it reaches to higher degree. The attack of fever is not associated with rigors and chills. This type of fever is usually rare.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of fever that does not follow a particular pattern. This occurs due to inflammation of organs.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of humoral fever in which the patient feels heat outside the body but cold from inside.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of humoral fever in which the patient feels heat inside the body but cold from outside. It is of two type; moderate and severe.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of Ḥummā Līfūriya, caused due to the predominance of Ṣafrā’ (yellow bile).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A fever that combines the features of Afyālūs and Līfūriya.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of fever that is sanguinous in nature and rises with the passage of time. It is of two types: Muṭbiqa Ghalayāniyya and Muṭbiqa ‘Ufūniyya.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of fever that occurs due to the involvement of blood. The fever starts without rigors and chills. The symptoms are similar to the symptoms produced due to the predominance of blood in the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of fever occurring due to severe putrefaction or sepsis. It is of three types: 1. Mutazā’ida, in which the symptoms gradually increases till the onset of fever, 2. Mutanāqiṣa, in which the symptoms gradually decreases till the onset of fever, 3. Mutasāwiya, in which the symptoms remain same till the onset of fever.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: When the attack of fever repeats after five days.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: When the attack of fever repeats after six days.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: When the attack of fever repeats after seven days.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: When the attack of fever repeats after nine days.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of fever accompanied with altered sensorium because the causative humour i.e. phlegm and yellow bile affects the brain of the patient.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of continuous and infectious fever which involves intestines. It usually lasts for 21 days or more and small eruptions appear on the skin.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of fever which affects the population of a particular area during a specific period. It is caused by water, air or soil pollution.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of fever that is accompanied with eruptions of different colours and sizes.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A severe infectious disease which spreads in the form of epidemic. In this condition, there is a high degree of fever and eruptions appear after three days.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An infectious fever which is continuous in nature. This is accompanied with eruptions and infections of nasal cavity. Eruptions are scattered all over the body but are not big in size and similar to millet.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An infectious type of fever with eruptions of crimson red colour. This is usually accompanied with inflammation of throat and kidney.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

Fever due to unhygienic living condition
concepts.definition: A type of eruptive fever without the involvement of any organ. There is marked weakness. Sometimes there is congestion of lungs. Living in unhygienic condition, damp places and malnutrition are predisposing causes of this fever. This fever is accompanied with delirium and coma.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of eruptive fever in which the symptoms are not severe. The eruptions are colourless, bigger in size. Fever is usually not high. There is no marked weakness. It is not accompanied with delirium and coma.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: Fever due to sweet and saline or vitreous or sour phlegm
concepts.definition: A type of fever caused by Balgham Zujājī (vitreous phlegm) and Balgham Shor (saline phlegm). This fever does not last for a long time.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of melancholic fever which occurs after five, six, seven, eight or nine days.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: Bleeding under skin due to fever
concepts.definition: Haemorrhages occurring beneath the skin, petechial or bigger in size and caused by fevers e.g. Ḥummā Ghāmiyya, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of infectious fever caused by the organism found in the stagnant water. This is characterised by enlargement of spleen.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Diseases of bones and joints

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Pain of the back can be superficial or deep. It can be due to cold impaired temperament, predominance of phlegm, physical exertion, incorrect sitting posture, increased sexual activity, weakness of kidneys, premenstrual pain, labour pain, congestion of portal vein and aorta.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Pain of the lower portion of back.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inflammation and pain of joints with redness of the skin. Sometimes it involves heart.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of arthalgia which involves several joints. As per involvement of humours it is of four types i.e. Damawī, Balghamī, Ṣafrāwī and Sawdāwī. According to severity of symptoms it is again divided into acute and chronic type. When two humours are involved this is known as Waja‘ al-Mafāṣil Murakkab.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Pain of hip joint. Its causes are same as Waja‘ al-Mafāṣil.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Severe pain in the heel which is also known as Nuzūl al-Mā’ i.e. infiltration of water. It is caused by the infiltration of acrid humours after pain.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A specific type of swelling and pain that occurs in foot specially great toe. But sometimes it may affect wrist and fingers of hand also. According to Ibn Hubal, toe joints are known as Inqūrūs from which the word Niqris been derived. It is a heredity disease.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of pain which originates from the hip joints and runs along with the sciatic nerve. Intensity of pain increases with the quantity of matter.This pain causes wasting of the muscles of legs due to disuse.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The ossification of joints and reduced joint spaces leading to locking of the joints.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A deformity in which there is backward bending of the vertebral column.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Forward bending of chest.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Dislocation of vertebral column at one side.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Displacement of vertebral column commonly seen in tubercular patients. In this a chronic ulcer damages the vertebral column up to the gangrenous stage. Due to this destruction, there is displacement of vertebral column.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.preferredTerm: Wahn al-‘Iẓām/ Takhalkhul al-‘Iẓām/ Takhaththur al-‘Iẓām
concepts.transliteration: Wahn al-‘Izam/ Takhalkhul al-‘Izam/ Takhaththur al-‘Izam

وهن العظام/ تخلخل العظام/ تخثر العظام
concepts.definition: It means weakness of bones in old age or pain of bones after trauma and injury. Bones are more prone to fractures in this condition.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Discontinuity/breaking of bones.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: In this condition, only the bone is broken and there is no discontinuity of skin and mucous membrane.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Breakage of bone associated with skin and mucous membrane. There is laceration of skin by the fragments of broken bone.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Breakage or discontinuity of bone along with the involvement of surrounding organs either artery or vein. It is either due to trauma from outside or puncture by the fragments of broken bones.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Complete breakage or discontinuity of the bone.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.preferredTerm: Kasr Ghayr Kāmil/ Kasr Juz’ī Kāmil
concepts.transliteration: Kasr Ghayr Kamil/ Kasr Juz’i Kamil
aliases: Kasr Ghayr Kāmil/ Kasr Juz’ī Kāmil
concepts.definition: Incomplete breaking or discontinuity of the bone.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The fracture of bone longitudinally. It occurs mostly in flat bones e.g. skull, scapula, etc. It is usually too small to trace.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An incomplete type of fracture which occurs mostly in children or ribs of older people. It resembles the breaking of fresh green branch of tree which when bended gets partially broken with some of its fibres remaining intact.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Crushing of a single bone into many pieces.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Breaking of bone with injury by some sharp objects and exposure of a piece of bone outside.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A perforating type of breakage of bone.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: In this type of fracture, breaking occurs longitudinally or in the length of bone.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: In this type of fracture, breaking of bone occurs transversally.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: In this type of fracture breaking of bone occurs obliquely.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: In this type of fracture, breaking of bone occurs in twisted manner or spiral manner.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of fracture in which broken long bones penetrate into the soft tissue.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The fracture of bones of foetus inside the uterus due to the trauma to the abdomen of expecting women.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Fracture of the bones of a new born due to bad obstetric procedure.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: In this type, there is a thinline fracture of bones.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A fracture that occurs in the bones due to some disease.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Fracture of the edges of bones.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Fracture of nasal bone.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: كسر فجلي/ كسر قصبي/ كسر قثوى
concepts.definition: Deep and broad fracture of the bones.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Broad and long fracture of bones.

كسر سويقي/ كسر قضيبي/ كسر جوزي/ كسر جريشي
concepts.definition: Crushed fracture of the bones.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is the slipping out of a bone from joint.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Dislocation of joints caused by two factors i.e. exogenous and endogenous. Exogenous factors, include trauma of the joint. Endogenous factors include the weakness of joint, ligaments etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Total deviation or displacement of bone from its adjoining bone.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of dislocation which is present at birth. It is caused either by the abnormal position of the foetus in the uterus or by defect in the process of formation of structure in foetal life. The most common congenital dislocation is the dislocation of hip joint.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of dislocation occurring due to joint diseases e.g. inflammation, pus formation or tubercular infection and other nerve disorders

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: When the head of the bone completely subluxates from its normal position

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.preferredTerm: Khal‘ Ghayr Tāmm/ Khal‘ Ghayr Kāmil/ Khal‘ Ghayr Mukammal
