خلع غير تام/ خلع غير كامل/ خلع غير مكمل
concepts.definition: When the head of the bone partially subluxates from its normal position.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: When there is injury of the skin with dislocation.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: When there is injury of vessels and bones with dislocation. This is a complicated type of dislocation.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: When there is fracture with dislocation of bone.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Partial displacement of the bone from its joint.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Surgery

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Breaches in the continuity of muscles and other tissues of the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Discontinuity of skin and mucous membrane which is exposed outside.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Wounds which are produced by sharp instruments or objects.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Wounds caused by pointed sharp objects that involve skin and underlying tissues.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Wounds with irregular and jagged edges and characterised by the massive destruction of tissues.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Wounds having six edges.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Closed blunt wounds not involving skin.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Wounds caused by the bite of poisonous animals.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Wounds caused by burn.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Wounds that are infected and suppurated.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Wounds that are not infected and not suppurated.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A systemic disease associated with the presence, multiplication and formation of septic emboli in the blood.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition which results from the spread of bacterial products or toxins in the blood stream.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Presence of pus in the blood with pyemic abscesses. This condition is marked by fevers, chills, sweating and abscess in various parts of the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Breach in the continuity of the epithelial membrane is known as ulcer. It is caused by some injury, abscess and skin eruptions.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of ulcer caused by pus forming bacteria.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of ulcer caused by specific causative organism e.g. syphilitic ulcers, tuberculous ulcers, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of ulcer that doesn’t heal easily or the healing is delayed.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of ulcer accompanied with pain.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of ulcer not accompanied with pain.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of ulcer that is easily healed.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of ulcer that is difficult to heal e.g. varicose ulcer.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A grave kind of ulcer, named after the person Khayrūn who first suffered from this.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of ulcer that has the tendency to spread by the continous discharge of pus.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of ulcer found on the skin surface as a scar mark with dark sloughing. It is caused due to the accumulation of burnt black bile.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of ulcer found in bed ridden patients. These ulcers are produced by the pressure, injury, anaemia and wet surface of the bed.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Ulcer which is clean.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Ulcer in which infection persists.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Ulcer in which there is plenty of viscid fluids.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Ulcer in which there is putrified material.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Ulcerating basal cell carcinoma of the skin.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: ulcer, associated with falling of hair around it
concepts.definition: Ulcer which is associated with falling of hair around it.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Ulcers with continuous discharge from them.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Ulcers which are hot in nature.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Ulcers which are cold in nature.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An ulcer found on the legs because of stasis or stagnation of blood in the veins.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Primarily, there is appearance of small papule on the skin. Later, there is increase in redness and burning. After about 10-15 days there is a formation of ulcer with intense red papule and crusts.There is a continous discharge from this ulcer and these are difficult to heal.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Ūdhīma is a Greek word meaning phlegmatic swelling. It is formed by the predominance of phlegm. It causes pitting on the site of swelling.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of parasitic disease. It starts with an eruption on the skin of the leg or hand or extremities or trunk more commonly on the calf muscles. After the ulceration of eruptions, a red thread like worm comes out from it which is quite long and its length gradually increases. This worm usually resides beneath the skin and creeps. There is pain at the site of worm. Sometimes, the number of these worms is about 40-50.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is a Greek word meaning decomposition of organs. It is a decomposed inflammation which is caused by putrified blood or without blood.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An initial stage of Shafāqalūs, in which colour of the affected part slightly changes due to decayed and putrified blood. There is no loss of sensitivity of the part. The innate energy of the part remains preserved i.e. there is no destruction of tissues of the affected part.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of gangrene caused by chronic obstruction of the arteries. In this condition the decayed organ becomes hard, dry and wrinkled. The colour of organ changes to dark brown.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Gangrene caused by obstruction of veins or occlusion of arteries abruptly.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A rapidly spreading gangrene in which decaying process is fast. The colour of the affected part changes to yellow, green,black and leads to toxaemia.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of gangrene that occurs as a result of complication of some other disease. It is of many types.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of gangrene that occurs as a result of obstruction of vessels.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of gangrene that occurs in old age.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of gangrene that occurs due to the pressure of thrombus in the arteries.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of gangrene that occurs due to diabetes.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of gangrene that occurs due to trauma or injury of a part.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of gangrene which develops when a part is exposed to extreme cold for a long duration of time.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An acute infective type of gangrene which spreads very rapidly and is accompanied with swelling.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A spot, rash or other mark appearing suddenly on the skin. According to content, they are classified into different types.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: According to Galen, small pustules are formed by the accumulation of morbid fluids which after being deviated towards skin gets collected in between the muscular layer and skin.This usually appears in those persons who have thick skin.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of eruption which occurs on the external ear or pinna. These are small, red coloured papules. These are caused by the derangement of blood, mixed with fluids.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Big sized, black coloured eruptions from which black pus is discharged. They mostly occur at the calf muscles. These are caused due to the accumulation of morbid humours in the calf muscles.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of abnormal eruptions which occur at nape of the neck. These are multiple, large and painful pustules. These are caused by acrid humour.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of abnormal eruptions which appear on face and cheeks in the form of hard pustules with redness around them. It involves the whole face in later stage.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Persistent eruptions on skin and mucous membrane.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Black coloured large papules which occur on calf musles and are suppurated.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: An ulcerated papule found on the cheeks and vagina. It resembles with mulberry. It occurs beneath the skin.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Small, white coloured pustules with roots as hard as tumour. Their outer ends are filled with pus. These are melancholic in nature.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of pustules that appear at different sites. These are due to accumulation of acrid blood in the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Fluctuant swelling which are more or less circular in shape and are filled with fluid or viscous material.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Hard nodules present in an organ. These do not resolve even after a long period of time.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: This is caused by the viscosity and derangement of the blood. There is predominance of black bile in the blood. Due to this, it accumulates in the organs causing swelling and inflammation.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It denotes the swelling of the organ due to the accumulation of viscous humours resulting in distension of the organs.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: In this type of swelling, gas gets accumulated in the spaces of organs. This is lighter in weight and cannot be pressed with pressure.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Acute swelling of the organs characterised by severe clinical features.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Swelling caused by cold humours.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Swelling occurs without putrifaction.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Swelling that occurs due to the involvement of humours. It may be Damawī, Balghamī, Ṣafrāwī and Sawdāwī. When it involves blood it is known as Falghamūnī. When it involves yellow bile, it is known as Namla wa Ḥumra. When it involves black bile, it is known as Saqīrūs and when it involves phlegm it is known as Waram Rikhw.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Swelling of an organ due to the involvement of blood. As this swelling is warm in nature and is accompanied with burning, it is included in Waram Ḥārr (acute inflammation) but most of the time its matter is blood. In this condition the site of swelling is distended, with severe pain which aggravates on pressure. This is more marked in the vascular organs.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A transudative type of swelling.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of chronic inflammation or swelling which is due to accumulation of black bile characterized by stony hardness and loss of sensation and pain. It starts with small swelling which later grows and sometimes it may transform into cancer. It is of two types: Saqīrūs Khāliṣ and Saqīrūs Ghayr Khāliṣ.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of movable swelling with varying size from gram seed to watermelon.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A tumour, formed by the tissues of some organs. These are often encapsulated and do not spread. They don’t recur once removed.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of spreading and recurring tumour. Sometimes these become ulcerated from which pus and other material comes out. These are accompanied with anaemia and general weakness of the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The content of this type of tumour is fat which is white in colour and very hard and can’t be compressed on pressure.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The content of this type of tumour resembles with that of honey. It is somewhat liquid and yellow in colour.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Contents of this type of tumour resemble with Ardhāla i.e. a semi solid preparation made of flour and clarified butter.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Contents of this type of tumour resemble a curry named Shīrāzī which is white in colour and prepared with milk. It is somewhat similar to Ḥarīra.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A tumour that occurs in face, urinary bladder, intestine, nerves and spinal cord. Content of this tumour are phlegm or phlegm like humour.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A tumour that occurs in retina, brain and spinal cord. It is composed of cartilaginous matter.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Contents of this type of tumour are fibrous and hair like. It is commonly found in the uterus.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of tumour found on the margins of long bones and it causes pain when it compresses the nerve.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of tumour that is found around the teeth.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A rare type of tumour which occurs on face or neck. This is formed from nerve fibres along with other tissues. It is not a fatal condition.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of tumour which occurs in the blood vessels.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of tumour which occurs in uterus, prostate glands and GI tract.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of tumour which arises from bone marrow.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Tumour of the glands.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of tumour of semi lunar shape.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Its literal meaning is “crab” as it sticks to its prey like a crab. It is a type of malignant, melancholic swelling which can occur anywhere in the body. It starts with a small swelling which gradually increases with time. It spreads very rapidly and the roots of this swelling are deep with prominent vessels. Sometimes it appears due to the accumulation of burnt yellow bile and phlegm.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: This malignant swelling is associated with ulceration and purulent discharge.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Its literal meaning is ‘ant’. These are one or more small red papules which cause severe burning and itching. This burning is similar to ant bite. These red papules spread along one line like ant that is why it is known as Namla or Sā‘iya. Its cause is the preponderance of bile or any abnormality in bile. It is of many types.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: When the red papules affect only the upper surface of the skin and cause burning and itching. It is due to the accumulation of yellow bile under the skin.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: When the papules get ulcerated these are known as Namla Muta’akkila.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: When the red papules appear on the lips, crusting appears with in 6-8 days and they finally disappear.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: When the red papules appear on the prepuce internally or externally. These cause severe itching and form blisters and internal papules which later changes into ulcers. External papules disappear within 7-8 days. Sometimes papules appear gradually which causes hardening of the prepuce.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: In this condition eruptions appear on the line of distribution of nerves which changes into transparent papules and causes severe burning and itching. Later, blisters with crusting appear within 10-14 days.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: In this condition, papules occur along the ophthalmic division of trigeminal nerve. These are generally accompanied by conjunctivitis and sometimes by keratitis.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of erythema in which vesicles occur. It is devoid of neuralgic pain. It usually subsides in four weeks.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: In this condition the papules are millet shaped. These are white in colour with red roots. They cause burning, pain and swelling at the site.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Eruptions of the skin in the form of bullous, containing watery fluid and sometimes blood. These resemble the blisters which are produced after burns. This is caused by the dilution of blood and collection of fluid beneath the skin which later on takes the shape of blisters. It is of two types: acute and chronic.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Blisters which occur during childhood. These blisters rupture quickly and black crust appears on them followed by the formation of cicatrix.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Sometimes blisters are accompanied with infection and decomposition of the tissues. This condition leads to weakness and death of the patient.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Initially a blister appears on the upper trunk then gradually small blisters appear around it which later join and yellow crust appears on these blisters. A specific type of smell occurs in the patient.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Blisters containing gases in place of fluids.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Collection of flat red papules which causes severe burning sensation resembling to fire burn. It immediately forms crusting of brown colour. It is caused by predominance of black bile.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Eruptions of the skin which are encrusted immediately after appearance. There is intense burning in these eruptions. There are reddish greenish lines on the skin at the site of eruptions which resemble flame of fire. Hence it is called Nār Fārsī. Nār Fārsī, is classified into many types depending on the nature of eruptions. These are plain, reddish, vesicular, pustular, hard and Shuqāqī.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The word Ṭā‘ūn is an altered form of the Unani word Ṭay‘ūn meaning inflammation of lymph glands of the body. It is the swelling of the body which is accompanied with severe pain and burning. The colour of the skin surrounding the swelling becomes blackish, reddish, bluish or greenish. It usually spreads in the form of epidemic. It is caused by poisonous substances which destroy the affected organs.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inflammation accompanied with swelling of the lymph glands of axilla, groin and neck. Before swelling there is high grade fever with rigors and chills, headache, nausea and vomiting. But after the appearance of swelling of lymph glands these symptoms subside.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The most severe and grave type of plague. In this condition there is generalized swelling of all the lymph glands of the body accompanied with fever, delirium, vomiting, diarrhoea and haemorrhage. Patient suffering from this type usually dies within 24 hours.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is a highly infectious type of plague in which infection spreads through droplets characterized by high fever, cough, passing of blood while coughing. This type has a bad prognosis.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A gangrenous ulcer of any part of the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inflammation, swelling and enlargement of the lymph glands of axilla and groin due to infections such as syphilis, tuberculosis, gonorrhoea, etc. It is due to the collection of morbid material from the organs. It can also be due to some ulcers of the skin.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of small abscess which can occur anywhere on the body. Initially it is red and causes severe pain. The condition mostly occurs in travellers and persons who do more physical and sternuous work.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Collection of fluid in the lymphatic channels due to their obstruction as a result of which the legs become swollen. But unlike varicose veins these channels are not visible under the skin. The leg and foot of the patient resemble with that of an elephant

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Dilatation, elongation and torsion of the veins which affects the legs of the patient. This is usually common in person who used to stand for a long time.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Burn injury with dry heat e.g flame, heated metal and heated objects.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Burning with lightning and thunder bolt.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Burning of the skin on exposure to strong sun rays.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Burn injury due to direct contact with the secretion of Balādur (Semecarpus anacardium).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Burn injury with radiation.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A parasitic disease in which there is worm infestation in the subcutaneous space. This worm travels inside the body and can reach up to the head. This travelling causes intense pain and burning. From head it usually comes out through the eyes and causes blindness. It can reach to any part of the body. Its treatment is either ligation and incision of a part to remove this worm or cauterization.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A condition where Waram Rīḥī travels in the body very fast like mercury. Its treatment is to ligate that particular part and cauterize it, otherwise cupping with fire can also be done on that part. If the affected part is difficult to locate then drugs which are used to evacuate phlegm from the body are used. This disease is seen in non-Arab females.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Abrasion of the skin which may be caused by friction of some hard objects on the skin.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Abrasion of the skin caused by improper shoes and leather socks.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Abrasion of the skin caused by tightening of rope or any ligature.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A chronic disease like tuberculosis which causes deformity of the organs and loss of organs in later stage. Sometimes, in few patients it is accompanied with ulceration of the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: In this type of leprosy there is no nodule formation but there is loss of sensation of organs. It is more commonly seen in tropical countries.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: In this type of leprosy there is nodule formation with deformity of organs. It is more commonly seen in cold countries.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Emaciation or cachexia that may be caused by 1. nutritional deficiencies e.g. intake of low fat diet 2. weakness of the faculties of stomach due to its cold temperament 3. after discontinuation of regular and strenuous exercise 4. bilious temperament of an individual 5. dysfunctioning of liver 6. worm infestation 7. excessive catabolism e.g. in case of chronic debilitating illnesses, excessive grief, sorrow, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Obesity is caused by leading a sedentary life and intake of fatty diets.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of cachexia of the body in which there is massive dryness of the body without fever. The patient looks like an old man in this condition.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Protrusion of an organ or a part of the organ through an abnormal opening from the abdominal cavity to outside. It can be caused by increased abdominal pressure due to chronic cough, pregnancy, chronic constipation, etc. It can also be due to injury or incision in the peritoneum.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Protrusion of a part of intestine from the inguinal canal into the scrotum.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Protrusion of a part of intestine into the inguinal canal.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of hernia which can be reduced back to its original position by manipulation.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of hernia which can not be reduced to its original position by manipulation.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of hernia in which the herniated part is so tightly constricted in the orifice that blood supply of the hernial sac gets disturbed leading to its gangrene.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of hernia in which the herniated part gets inflamed.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of hernia in which there is obstruction in the hernial sac because of extramural cause.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of hernia in which the herniated part comes out from deep inguinal ring into the inguinal canal.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of hernia in which the herniated part comes out through the hesselbach’s triangle.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of hernia which is present since birth . In this type, there is herniation of intestine in the scrotum

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of hernia in which a part of intestine herniates through the umbilicus. This occurs mostly in children , old people and young multipara women.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of hernia, in which a part of stomach herniates through the opening in the abdominal wall.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of hernia, in which a structure pushes through the wall of the femoral canal.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Displacement of abdominal muscle around umbilicus.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: A hard melancholic swelling with loss of sensation.
concepts.definition: A hard melancholic swelling with loss of sensation.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Inflammation of peritoneum. It is of two types: acute and chronic.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Poisoning

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Bite of any type of snake. It is characterized by inflammation, shivering, syncope, excessive perspiration, pale eyes, swelling and boil at the site of bite.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is characterized by acute firm swelling of the organ involved, piercing sensation followed by cold perspiration, trembling of lips, vomiting, shivering, cold extremities, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is characterized by redness, swelling and pain at the site of bite.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is characterized by bluish and greenish discoloration of the skin at the site of bite, nausea, vomiting and diarrhoea.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is characterized by cold sweat, itching all over the body, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is characterized by slight pain and itching initially which subsides after some time.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is characterized by severe pain, extreme burning sensation in the body, acute glossitis, heaviness of tongue, shivering and numbness of organs. Sometimes there is black discoloration of skin at the site of bite followed by putrefaction.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Bite of beaver is considered to be of grave consequences if bitten by a hungry beaver.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is characterized by convulsions and inflammation of tongue.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Human bite is the most dangerous when it is bitten by a hungry person.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Bite of wolf causes wounds which may putrefy if not managed properly.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is characterized by severe pain and greenish discoloration of skin at the site of bite.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is characterized by wound at the site of bite with pain. Gradually, the patient experiences nightmare, depression, fear of water, convulsions and tetanus. When this condition lasts the patient develops confusion. He often runs to bite other persons and whenever he/she sees water he/she starts to shiver.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is a general term used for bites by scorpions, wasps, spiders, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is characterized by excessive vomiting and diarrhoea, abdominal colic, asphyxia, dryness of mouth, heaviness and blackish discoloration of tongue, retrosternal burning, palpitation, redness of eyes, increased temperature of the body, etc. The cause of death in this type of poisoning is hepatic diarrhoea and haemetemesis.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is characterized by abdominal pain, severe tenesmus, bloody diarrhoea, heaviness of tongue, heaviness of stomach, retention of urine and oedema all over the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Its clinical features are same as Sammiyat-i-Sīmāb (mercury poisoning).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: It is characterized by generalized oedema of the body, breathlessness, sometimes asphyxia; colour of the skin is similar to that of Usrub (lead), colic, retention of urine, dryness of mouth, heaviness of tongue, stomach and intestine, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Its clinical features are same as that of Sammiyat-i-Murdārsaṉg (litharge poisoning).

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Its clinical features are headache, cancrum oris, dryness of mouth and abdominal pain.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Its clinical features are swollen lips, glossitis, exophthalmos, frequent respiration, halitosis, shock, weakness of calf muscles with difficulty in walking, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Severe restlessness and hiccups. Sometimes there is severe diarrhoea occasionally mixed with blood.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Its clinical features are severe burning in mouth, stomach and intestine, boils and eruptions in mouth and lips and high grade fever, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Its clinical features are severe restlessness, feeling of severe burning sensation in the body and flatulence.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Its clinical features are severe diarrhoea, asphyxia, palpitation, burning of tongue, excessive belching, flatulence etc. These are followed by convulsion, trembling and death.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Its clinical features are syncope and nausea.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Its clinical features are vertigo, giddiness, redness of eyes, intoxication and deep sleep. Patient will have cold sweats, pulsus parvus and shallow breathing, delirium, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Its clinical features are same as that of Sammiyat-i-Jawz Māthil. Moreover, there will be tetany, deafness, pruritus, deep sleep, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Its clinical features are flaccidity of organs, glossitis, chelitis, redness of eyes, vertigo and giddiness, diminished vision, breathlessness, pruritus, intoxication, delirium, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Its clinical features are diminished vision, cold extremities, severe distension, heaviness in body and thighs. Later it may cause convulsions, asphyxia and death.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Its clinical features are same as that of Sammiyat-i-Ajwā’in Khurāsānī.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Natural Pattern(s)

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A power endowed by nature to every individual for self preservation which regulates its normal functions. It is the administrator, protector and healer of the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The essential factors in association with the structure and functions of the body i.e. Arkān, Mizāj, Akhlāṭ, A‘ḍā’, Arwāḥ, Quwā and Af‘āl. Each of them is must to sustain the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: Simple bodies which are primary substances of human and non-human bodies. They can not be subdivided into bodies which have different forms. Their intermixture results in different forms in nature.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: One of the four primary substances found in nature, bearing the natural properties of heat and dryness. The role it plays in the construction of things is to mature, refine and intermingle with all things.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: One of the four primary substances found in nature, bearing the natural properties of heat and moisture. Its effect and value in (the world of) creation is to rarefy and render things finer, lighter, more delicate, softer and better able to move to the lighter spheres. Sometimes, this term is also used for the gases arising from different organs in their pathological state.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: One of the four primary substances found in nature, bearing the natural properties of cold and moistness. Its purpose in (the world of) creation lies in the fact that it lends itself readily to dispersion and consequently assumes any non-permanent shape.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: One of the four primary substances found in nature bearing the natural properties of cold and dryness. Its purpose in the (world of) creation is to fix and hold the being together into a compacted form

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A quality that is produced by action and reaction of opposite qualities of elements which are broken up in small particles in order to facilitate their mixing. When these components interact among themselves, a condition is produced, which is found in equal proportion in all the particles of the compound.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The temperament in which the hot and dry physical properties dominate the other two physical properties i.e. cold and moist.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The temperament in which the hot and moist physical properties dominate the other two physical properties i.e. cold and dry.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The temperament in which the cold and dry physical properties dominate the other two physical properties i.e. hot and moist.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The temperament in which the cold and moist properties dominate on the other two physical properties i.e. hot and dry

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The fluids of the body that serve the functions of nutrition, growth and repair of the organs.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: One of the four basic humours, red in color bearing hot and wet temperament. It is excellent among all the humours.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: One of the four basic humours which is white in colour and bears cold and wet temperament. It is next to sanguine humour in excellence

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: One of the four basic humours. It is yellow in colour and has hot and dry temperament. It is next to phlegm in excellence.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: One of the four basic humours. It is black coloured and has cold and dry temperament.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A light gaseous substance found in organs and fluids of the body and performs various important functions. It is obtained from the interaction of inspired air with Akhlāṭ Laṭīfa.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The Rūḥ (pneuma) which is found in the organs of psychic faculty and its centre is brain.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The Rūḥ (pneuma) which is found in the organs of vital faculty and its centre is heart.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The Rūḥ (pneuma) which is found in the organs of natural faculty and its centre is liver.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The solid parts of the body which are derived primarily from the coarse humours. These are the essential tools to accomplish vivid functions.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The organs in which the visible and perceptible parts carry the same name and definitions as the whole organ e.g. flesh, nerve, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The organs in which the comprising parts irrespective of size differ in nature as well as name for the whole organ.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A natural and specialized ability of the body for the performance of its specific function.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The natural and specialized power which is furnished in an individual for digestion and assimilation of food and evacuation of waste from the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The power which is furnished in an individual for the intellectual, sensory and motor function of the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The power which is furnished in an individual to receive other powers essential for the survival.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The natural and specialized powers which are furnished in an individual for preservation of its species.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The bodily activity essential for fulfilling the objectives of the body. It is performed by the organs and also testimony to the presence of powers in them.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The functions which are vital for the survival. These are performed by Quwā Ḥaywāniyya and executed by A‘ḍā’ Ḥaywāniyya.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The functions that are performed by the psychic faculty of the body. These are performed by Quwā Nafsāniyya and executed by A‘ḍā’ Nafsāniyya.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The functions which are essential to energize all the powers and develop the organs. These are performed by Quwā Ṭabī‘iyya and executed by A‘ḍā’ Ṭabī‘iyya.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The state of health in which the structure and functions of the body are in normal state.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The intermediate state of the body, in between, the state of health and the state of disease. It is a state of neither health nor disease

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The four natural properties or qualities associated with matter. These are hot, cold, moist and dry.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The two active properties i.e. hot and cold.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: One of the four physical properties naturally associated with matter.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: One of the four physical properties naturally associated with matter.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The two passive physical properties i.e. moist and dry

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: One of the four physical properties naturally associated with matter.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: One of the four physical properties naturally associated with matter.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The innate heat of the body regulated by medicatrix naturae for the normal functioning of the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The term used for the process of digestion and transformation of the food particles to become the parts of the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The four different types of digestion i.e. Haḍm Mi‘dī, Haḍm Kabidī, Haḍm ‘Urūqī, Haḍm ‘Uḍwī which the food particles have to go through for the purpose of assimilation in the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The first stage of food digestion which occurs inside the alimentary canal to form chime.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The second stage of food digestion which takes place at the site of liver to form chyle.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The third stage of digestion which takes place inside the vessels. This helps in the assimilation of food so that it becomes the part of the body.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The fourth stage of digestion which takes place in the organs.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The temperament of an individual in different phases of life.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: The temperament of human being which is considered to be the most perfect and noble in comparison with all other species. This temperament is inclined towards heat.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of temperament caused by the predominance of Dam (sanguine) in the body. It is hot and moist. The individuals with this type of temperament have strong built, full pulse, pinkish colour of skin, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of temperament caused by the predominance of Balgham (phlegm) in the body. It is cold and moist. The individuals with this type of temperament have fatty body, excessive sleep, whitish colour of skin, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of temperament caused by the predominance of Ṣafrā’ (yellow bile) in the body. It is hot and dry. The individuals with this type of temperament have thin built, yellowish colour of the skin, rapid pulse, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: A type of temperament caused by the predominance of Sawdā’ (black bile) in the body. It is cold and dry. The individuals with this type of temperament have thin built with prominent veins, blackish color of the skin, etc.

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: sanguine humour, devoid of its normal qualities either through change of temperament such as getting hot or cold or due to admixture with the humours derived from outside or produced within the sanguine humour, e.g., when a part of it gets putrefied, the lighter portion is converted into abnormal yellow bile and the heavier portion into abnormal black bile

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: phlegm devoid of basic characters of normal phlegm

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: one of the abnormal types of phlegm, which is saline or alkaline in taste and inclined towards heat and dryness

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: one of the abnormal types of phlegm, which is sour in taste and inclined towards coldness and dryness

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: one of the abnormal types of phlegm, which is tasteless, very immature and quite cold

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: one of the abnormal types of phlegm, which is gallic in taste and inclined towards coldness and dryness

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: one of the abnormal types of phlegm, which is sweet in taste and inclined towards heat and moistness

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: one of the abnormal types of phlegm, having watery consistency

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: one of the abnormal types of phlegm, having extremely thick consistency

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: one of the abnormal types of phlegm, having mucoid consistency

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: one of the abnormal types of phlegm, having vitreous consistency

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: one of the abnormal types of phlegm, having foul smell, produced by sepsis/infection/putrefaction

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: yellow bile that becomes abnormal either due to addition of extraneous material or alteration in its own composition

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: one of the abnormal types of yellow bile, produced by the admixture of thick phlegm

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: one of the abnormal types of yellow bile, produced by the admixture of thin phlegm

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: one of the abnormal types of yellow bile, produced by the admixture of burnt black bile

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: one of the abnormal types of yellow bile, produced by the combustion of ordinary yellow bile, resulting in development of leek green colour due to mixing of the burnt material with the original yellow bile

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: the hottest and the most lethal of all abnormal types of yellow bile produced due to extreme combustion of leek green bile

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: black bile produced either by the combustion of black bile itself or combustion of any of the other three humours, i.e., sanguine, phlegm, yellow bile

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: one of the abnormal types of black bile, produced by the combustion of sanguine

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: one of the abnormal types of black bile, produced by the combustion of yellow bile

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: one of the abnormal types of black bile, produced by the combustion of phlegm

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: one of the abnormal types of black bile, produced by the combustion of black bile itself

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

concepts.definition: single disease is produced either due to the abnormality of temperament or composition or breach in continuity

source.version: NAMASTE national morbidity code files (repository snapshot 2025)

aliases: abnormal temperament/morbid temperament/ impaired temperament/immoderate temperament
concepts.definition: temperament wherein the qualities and quantities of all the participating primary components in a compound are not in accordance with the natural needs

aliases: مزاج غیر معتدل مفرد/سوء مزاج مفرد
concepts.definition: imbalance of temperament occurring due to dominance of any one of the four qualities, i.e., heat, cold, dryness, moistness, on the other three qualities
